recipes.name: Overnight Oats
recipes.description: No-cook oats soaked overnight with milk and chia — grab-and-go breakfast.
steps: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, chia and sweetener in a jar.
Stir well, cover, and refrigerate overnight (at least 6 hours).
In the morning, top with berries and eat cold or warmed.
tips: Swap berries for sliced banana or apple.
Add a spoon of nut butter for staying power.

recipes.name: Veggie Omelette
recipes.description: Fluffy three-egg omelette folded around sautéed peppers, spinach and cheese.
steps: Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat and soften the pepper for 2 minutes.
Add spinach and let it wilt, then pour in the eggs.
As the edges set, lift them to let raw egg flow underneath.
Scatter cheese over one half, fold, and slide onto a plate.
tips: Keep the heat moderate — high heat browns and toughens eggs.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
recipes.description: Layers of thick Greek yogurt, granola and fruit — five minutes, no cooking.
steps: Spoon half the yogurt into a glass.
Add a layer of granola and berries.
Repeat the layers, drizzle with honey and top with nuts.
tips: Add the granola just before eating so it stays crunchy.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast
recipes.description: Smashed avocado on toasted sourdough with lemon, chili flakes and flaky salt.
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Spread over the toast and finish with chili flakes.
Top with a fried or poached egg if you want more protein.
tips: A ripe avocado yields easily to gentle pressure near the stem.

recipes.name: Grilled Lemon Herb Chicken
recipes.description: Juicy chicken breasts marinated in lemon, garlic and herbs, then seared.
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Coat the chicken and marinate 15 minutes (or up to 4 hours).
Heat a grill pan over medium-high.
Cook 6–7 minutes per side until the internal temp reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing.
tips: Pound the breasts to even thickness so they cook through evenly.

recipes.name: One-Pan Salmon & Asparagus
recipes.description: Sheet-pan salmon and asparagus roasted with lemon and garlic — one tray, 20 minutes.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan.
Toss asparagus with half the oil, salt and pepper; spread on the pan.
Nestle the salmon among the asparagus, brush with the rest of the oil and garlic.
Lay lemon slices over the fish.
Roast 12–15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
tips: Thicker fillets need a couple extra minutes; thin asparagus cooks fast.

recipes.name: Chickpea Coconut Curry
recipes.description: Creamy coconut and tomato curry with chickpeas and spinach over rice.
steps: Sauté the onion in oil until soft, then add garlic and curry powder.
Stir in tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk; simmer 15 minutes.
Fold in spinach until wilted and season to taste.
Serve over rice.
tips: A squeeze of lime at the end brightens the whole dish.

recipes.name: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Fast wok stir-fry of sliced beef and broccoli in a glossy soy-ginger sauce.
steps: Toss the beef with cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and sear the beef in batches; remove.
Stir-fry the broccoli 3 minutes with a splash of water to steam.
Add garlic and ginger, return the beef, and pour in the rest of the soy sauce.
Toss until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
tips: Slice the beef against the grain for tenderness.

recipes.name: Turkey Chili
recipes.description: Hearty one-pot chili with ground turkey, beans and warm spices.
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion in a large pot.
Stir in chili powder and cumin and cook 1 minute.
Add beans, tomatoes and broth.
Simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season and serve with your favorite toppings.
tips: It tastes even better the next day.

recipes.name: Margherita Flatbread
recipes.description: Crisp flatbread with tomato, fresh mozzarella and basil.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Spread sauce over the flatbread and add mozzarella and tomatoes.
Bake 10–12 minutes until the cheese bubbles and the edges crisp.
Finish with basil and a drizzle of olive oil.
tips: Bake directly on the rack for an extra-crisp base.

recipes.name: Classic Guacamole
recipes.description: Chunky avocado dip with lime, onion, cilantro and a little chili.
steps: Halve the avocados, scoop into a bowl and mash to your preferred texture.
Stir in the lime juice and salt right away to keep the color bright.
Fold in onion, tomato, cilantro and jalapeño.
Taste and adjust salt and lime, then serve.
tips: Press plastic wrap directly onto the surface to slow browning.
Mash some, leave some chunky, for the best texture.

recipes.name: Roasted Garlic Broccoli
recipes.description: Broccoli roasted hot with garlic until the edges char and crisp.
ingredients: 1 large head broccoli, cut into florets
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the florets with oil, garlic, salt and pepper.
Spread on a sheet pan in a single layer.
Roast 20–22 minutes until deeply browned at the edges.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon.
tips: Don't crowd the pan or the broccoli steams instead of roasting.

parsed_ingredients.raw: 1 large head broccoli, cut into florets

recipes.name: Smooth Hummus
recipes.description: Silky blended chickpeas with tahini, lemon and garlic.
steps: Blend tahini and lemon juice first until creamy.
Add garlic, chickpeas, oil and salt.
Blend, adding reserved chickpea liquid a spoon at a time until smooth.
Spread in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil and serve.
tips: Blending the tahini and lemon first is the secret to a fluffy texture.

recipes.name: Quinoa Tabbouleh
recipes.description: Bright herb salad of quinoa, parsley, tomato and lemon.
steps: Combine the cooled quinoa, parsley, tomato and cucumber.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Pour over the salad and toss.
Chill 15 minutes to let the flavors meld.
tips: Use lots of parsley — it should taste like an herb salad with quinoa, not the reverse.

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Avocado Mousse
recipes.description: Rich, silky chocolate mousse built on ripe avocado — no dairy.
steps: Blend all ingredients in a food processor until completely smooth.
Scrape down and blend again so no avocado streaks remain.
Spoon into cups and chill at least 30 minutes.
Top with berries or shaved chocolate.
tips: Very ripe avocados blend smoothest and hide their flavor best.

recipes.name: 3-Ingredient Banana Oat Cookies
recipes.description: Soft, naturally sweet cookies from banana, oats and chocolate chips.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet.
Mash the bananas and stir in the oats, chocolate chips and cinnamon.
Scoop into 12 mounds and flatten slightly.
Bake 12–15 minutes until set at the edges.
tips: The riper the banana, the sweeter the cookie.

recipes.name: Berry Chia Pudding
recipes.description: Chia seeds set overnight into a thick pudding, layered with berries.
steps: Whisk chia, milk, syrup and vanilla.
Wait 5 minutes, whisk again to break up clumps.
Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight.
Layer with berries and serve.
tips: The second whisk after 5 minutes prevents a clumpy set.

recipes.name: Almond Flour Banana Bread
recipes.description: Moist, grain-free banana bread made with almond flour.
ingredients: 1/4 cup melted butter or coconut oil
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a loaf pan.
Whisk the bananas, eggs, syrup and melted butter.
Stir in almond flour, baking soda and cinnamon until just combined.
Pour into the pan and smooth the top.
Bake 45–50 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the pan 15 minutes before turning out.
tips: Almond-flour loaves are delicate when hot — let it cool before slicing.

parsed_ingredients.raw: 1/4 cup melted butter or coconut oil

recipes.name: Classic Buttermilk Pancakes
recipes.description: Tall, fluffy pancakes with crisp edges and a tender crumb.
steps: Whisk the dry ingredients in one bowl and the wet in another.
Fold the wet into the dry until just combined — lumps are fine.
Rest the batter 5 minutes.
Cook 1/4-cup portions on a buttered griddle over medium heat.
Flip when bubbles form and the edges look dry; cook 1 more minute.
tips: Don't overmix — a few lumps make for fluffier pancakes.

recipes.name: Soft Cinnamon Rolls
recipes.description: Pillowy yeast rolls swirled with cinnamon sugar and topped with glaze.
ingredients: Filling: 1/2 cup brown sugar + 2 tbsp cinnamon + 1/4 cup butter
Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar + 2 tbsp milk
steps: Mix warm milk, yeast and sugar; let it foam 5 minutes.
Add egg, butter and flour; knead into a soft dough.
Cover and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour.
Roll into a rectangle, spread with butter and cinnamon sugar.
Roll up tightly, slice into 12, and place in a buttered pan.
Rise 30 minutes, then bake at 350°F for 22–25 minutes.
Whisk the glaze and pour over the warm rolls.
tips: Use floss to slice clean rolls without squashing them.

recipes.name: Flaky Butter Croissants
recipes.description: Laminated, buttery croissants — a weekend project with a beautiful payoff.
steps: Mix flour, milk, yeast, sugar and salt into a dough; chill 1 hour.
Pound the cold butter into a flat square.
Encase the butter in the rolled dough and fold in thirds.
Roll and fold twice more, chilling 30 minutes between folds.
Roll thin, cut triangles, and roll each into a crescent.
Proof 2 hours until puffy, brush with egg wash.
Bake at 400°F for 18–20 minutes until deep golden.
tips: Keep everything cold — warm butter ruins the layers.
Spread the project over two days if it's your first time.

recipes.name: Green Protein Smoothie
recipes.description: Spinach, banana and protein blended into a creamy on-the-go breakfast.
steps: Add the liquid first, then the rest of the ingredients.
Blend until completely smooth.
Add more milk to loosen or more ice to thicken.
tips: Freeze the banana ahead for a thicker, frostier smoothie.

recipes.name: Golden Turmeric Latte
recipes.description: Warming spiced milk with turmeric, ginger and a touch of honey.
steps: Warm the milk in a small pot over medium heat.
Whisk in turmeric, ginger, pepper and cinnamon.
Heat until steaming but not boiling.
Stir in honey and pour into a mug.
tips: The pinch of black pepper helps your body absorb the turmeric.

recipes.name: Bacon & Egg Breakfast Cups
recipes.description: Muffin-tin egg cups baked with bacon, cheddar and spinach — a grab-and-go keto breakfast you can make ahead.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F and grease a 6-cup muffin tin.
Cook the bacon in a skillet until just shy of crisp, then line the wall of each muffin cup with a slice.
Whisk the eggs with the heavy cream, spinach, cheddar, salt and pepper.
Divide the egg mixture between the cups and bake 18–20 minutes, until set and puffed.
Cool 2 minutes, then run a knife around each and lift out.
tips: Swap the spinach for diced bell pepper or sautéed mushrooms.
Keep refrigerated up to 4 days — reheat 30 seconds in the microwave.

recipes.name: Avocado Tuna Salad
recipes.description: A creamy no-cook tuna salad bound with mashed avocado instead of mayo — ready in five minutes.
steps: Mash the avocado in a bowl until mostly smooth.
Add the tuna, mayonnaise, celery, red onion and lemon juice.
Fold together and season with salt and pepper.
Serve in lettuce cups or with cucumber slices.
tips: A teaspoon of Dijon mustard adds a nice tang.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Cheese Mash
recipes.description: Buttery cauliflower blended with cheddar and cream — a low-carb stand-in for mashed potatoes.
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, cut into florets
steps: Steam or boil the cauliflower florets until very tender, about 12 minutes.
Drain very well, then add to a food processor with the butter, cream and garlic.
Blend until smooth, then pulse in the cheddar.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
tips: Drain the cauliflower thoroughly so the mash isn't watery.

parsed_ingredients.raw: 1 large head cauliflower, cut into florets

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites
recipes.description: Seared sirloin cubes tossed in garlic butter — a fast, rich keto main that's done in 20 minutes.
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch cubes
steps: Pat the steak cubes dry and season well with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over high heat and sear the steak in a single layer for 2–3 minutes without moving.
Flip and sear another 1–2 minutes for medium.
Lower the heat, add the butter, garlic and thyme, and toss to coat for 1 minute.
Rest briefly, then serve.
tips: Don't crowd the pan — sear in two batches for a proper crust.

parsed_ingredients.raw: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch cubes

recipes.name: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
recipes.description: Spiralized zucchini tossed with basil pesto and parmesan — pasta night without the carbs.
steps: Spiralize the zucchini into noodles and pat dry.
Warm the olive oil in a skillet and sauté the zoodles for 2–3 minutes, just until tender.
Remove from the heat and toss with the pesto, parmesan and tomatoes.
Season and serve immediately.
tips: Salt the zoodles and drain 10 minutes first for firmer, less watery noodles.

recipes.name: Keto Cobb Salad
recipes.description: A loaded Cobb with chicken, bacon, egg, avocado and blue cheese over crisp greens.
steps: Spread the chopped romaine across a platter.
Arrange rows of chicken, bacon, egg, avocado and blue cheese on top.
Whisk the olive oil and vinegar with salt and pepper.
Drizzle over the salad and serve.
tips: Use leftover rotisserie chicken to make this a 10-minute meal.

recipes.name: Almond Butter Fat Bombs
recipes.description: No-bake chocolate almond-butter bites that melt in your mouth — a portion-controlled keto sweet fix.
steps: Stir the almond butter, melted coconut oil, cocoa, sweetener, vanilla and salt until smooth.
Spoon into a silicone mini-muffin or candy mold.
Freeze 30 minutes until firm.
Pop out and store in the freezer.
tips: Keep them frozen — they soften quickly at room temperature.

recipes.name: Baked Eggs in Avocado
recipes.description: Avocado halves baked with an egg in each well and a little cheese — a two-ingredient keto breakfast.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Scoop out a little avocado so an egg fits in each half, and nestle the halves in a baking dish so they sit level.
Crack an egg into each well and sprinkle with cheddar, salt and pepper.
Bake 14–16 minutes, until the whites are set.
Garnish with chives and serve.
tips: Use small or medium eggs so they don't overflow the well.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Spaghetti Squash
recipes.description: Roasted spaghetti squash strands tossed with cherry tomatoes, feta, olives and basil — a light, veggie-forward Mediterranean dinner.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Halve the squash lengthwise, scoop out the seeds, rub with 1 tbsp olive oil and season.
Roast cut-side down on a baking sheet for 35–40 minutes, until tender.
Meanwhile, warm the remaining oil in a pan and soften the garlic and cherry tomatoes for 3–4 minutes.
Scrape the squash into strands with a fork and toss with the tomatoes, feta, olives and basil.
Season and serve warm.
tips: Roast the squash a day ahead and reheat to make this a fast weeknight meal.

recipes.name: Quinoa Power Bowl
recipes.description: A hearty bowl of quinoa, roasted sweet potato, chickpeas and massaged kale with a lemon-tahini drizzle.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potato and chickpeas with olive oil, salt and pepper, and roast 20–25 minutes.
Massage the kale with a pinch of salt until softened.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and a splash of water into a pourable sauce.
Build bowls with quinoa, kale, roasted sweet potato and chickpeas, and drizzle with the tahini sauce.
tips: Roast a big tray of sweet potato and chickpeas to bowl up lunches all week.

recipes.name: Greek Chicken Bowl
recipes.description: Grilled oregano chicken over brown rice with cucumber, tomato, feta and tzatziki — a fresh Greek-style bowl.
steps: Season the chicken with oregano, salt, pepper and olive oil.
Grill or pan-sear 5–6 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice.
Divide the brown rice between bowls and top with chicken, cucumber, tomatoes and feta.
Finish with a spoon of tzatziki.
tips: Marinate the chicken in lemon and oregano for an hour for more flavor.

recipes.name: Lentil & Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: A cozy, fiber-rich soup of brown lentils, carrots, celery and tomato, finished with a handful of spinach.
steps: Warm the olive oil in a pot and soften the onion, carrots and celery for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, lentils, diced tomatoes and broth.
Simmer 25–30 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, season and serve.
tips: It thickens as it sits — loosen with a little broth when reheating.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
recipes.description: A no-cook chickpea salad with cucumber, cherry tomatoes, feta and herbs in a lemon-olive-oil dressing.
steps: Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, feta, red onion and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk the olive oil and lemon juice with salt and pepper.
Toss to coat and let sit 10 minutes before serving.
tips: Keeps 3 days in the fridge — a great make-ahead lunch.

recipes.name: Spinach & Mushroom Frittata
recipes.description: A baked egg frittata loaded with spinach, mushrooms and a little parmesan — make-ahead breakfast or brunch.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Sauté the mushrooms and garlic in olive oil in an oven-safe skillet until softened.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted.
Whisk the eggs with milk, parmesan, salt and pepper, and pour into the skillet.
Cook 2 minutes on the stovetop, then bake 15–18 minutes until set.
tips: Use any leftover vegetables — peppers, zucchini or tomatoes all work.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Tacos
recipes.description: Roasted spiced sweet potato and black beans in warm corn tortillas with avocado and a squeeze of lime.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potato with olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper, and roast 20–25 minutes.
Warm the black beans in a small pan.
Heat the tortillas.
Fill with sweet potato, black beans and avocado, and finish with a squeeze of lime.
tips: Add a spoon of salsa or pickled onions for extra punch.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs gently poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce — a savory Mediterranean breakfast or brunch.
steps: Warm the olive oil in a skillet and soften the onion and bell pepper for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, season, and simmer 10 minutes until thickened.
Make wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs; cover and cook 6–8 minutes until the whites set.
Garnish with parsley and serve from the pan.
tips: Serve with whole-grain bread to scoop up the sauce.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Hash with Eggs
recipes.description: A skillet of crispy spiced sweet potato, peppers and greens with eggs cracked right in — a hearty one-pan breakfast.
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and diced small
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add the diced sweet potato. Cook, stirring occasionally, 10–12 minutes until tender and browned.
Add the bell pepper, onion and garlic and cook 4–5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the smoked paprika and spinach, season with salt and pepper, and cook until the spinach wilts.
Make 4 wells in the hash, crack an egg into each, cover, and cook 4–6 minutes until the whites set.
Season and serve hot from the pan.
tips: Dice the sweet potato small (about 1/2 inch) so it cooks through and crisps quickly.
Keep the pan covered while the eggs cook to steam them to your preferred doneness.

parsed_ingredients.raw: 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and diced small

recipes.name: Berry Almond Breakfast Shake
recipes.description: A thick blended morning shake with berries, oats and Greek yogurt for slow-release energy.
steps: Add the milk and yogurt to the blender first.
Layer in the oats, berries, almond butter and honey.
Blend on high for 60-90 seconds until thick and smooth.
Pour into a tall glass and drink right away.
tips: Soak the oats in the milk for a few minutes first for a smoother blend.
Use frozen berries and skip the ice for an even thicker shake.

recipes.name: Tropical Green Morning Smoothie
recipes.description: Spinach hidden behind sweet mango and pineapple — a bright, blended start to the day.
steps: Add the coconut milk to the blender, then the spinach.
Add the mango, pineapple, banana and chia seeds.
Blend until completely smooth and pale green.
Pour over ice and serve.
tips: Frozen tropical fruit gives the creamiest texture — skip the ice if using it.
Let it sit two minutes so the chia thickens slightly before drinking.

recipes.name: Tart Cherry Bedtime Shake
recipes.description: A calming blended night shake with tart cherry and almond — naturally rich in magnesium and melatonin precursors.
steps: Add the milk and yogurt to the blender.
Add the cherries, banana, almond butter and cinnamon.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and sip about an hour before bed.
tips: Tart cherry and the magnesium in almond butter both support restful sleep.
Skip the ice — a slightly warmer, thicker shake is more soothing at night.

recipes.name: Chocolate Casein Nightcap
recipes.description: A rich chocolate blended shake built on slow-digesting dairy protein to feed muscles overnight.
steps: Add the milk to the blender, then the protein powder and cocoa.
Add the banana, almond butter and honey.
Blend until smooth, thick and frothy.
Pour into a mug or glass and enjoy before bed.
tips: A casein or blended dairy protein digests slowly — ideal for an overnight shake.
Warm the milk first and blend gently for a hot-cocoa version.

recipes.name: Cold Brew Protein Shake
recipes.description: No blender needed — just shake cold brew, milk and protein for a grab-and-go morning iced coffee.
steps: Add the protein powder and a splash of the milk to a shaker bottle.
Shake hard for 15 seconds to break up any clumps.
Add the cold brew, remaining milk and cinnamon and shake again.
Pour over ice and drink.
tips: No shaker? Whisk the protein into a little milk first, then stir in the rest.
Use a chocolate or vanilla protein to flavour it without added syrup.

recipes.name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Shake
recipes.description: A shaken (no-blender) chocolate peanut butter shake — fast, drinkable and high in protein.
steps: Warm the peanut butter for a few seconds so it loosens, then add to a shaker bottle.
Add the protein powder, cocoa, honey and a splash of milk and shake well.
Add the remaining milk and shake until smooth.
Pour over ice and drink straight away.
tips: Powdered peanut butter dissolves more easily if you do not have a blender.
Shake in two stages — a thick paste first, then thin it out — to avoid lumps.

recipes.name: Blueberry Oat Muffins
recipes.description: Hearty whole-grain muffins studded with blueberries and oats, lightly sweetened with honey.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F and line a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk the flour, oats and baking soda in a bowl.
In another bowl mix the yogurt, honey, eggs, milk and olive oil.
Fold the wet into the dry, then gently fold in the blueberries.
Divide between the cups and bake 20–22 minutes, until golden.
tips: Toss the blueberries in a little flour so they don't sink to the bottom.

recipes.name: Whole Wheat Zucchini Bread
recipes.description: A moist whole-wheat quick bread packed with grated zucchini, walnuts and warm cinnamon.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
Squeeze the excess water from the grated zucchini.
Whisk the eggs, honey and olive oil, then stir in the zucchini.
Fold in the flour, cinnamon and baking soda, then the walnuts.
Pour into the pan and bake 45–50 minutes, until a tester comes out clean.
tips: Squeeze the zucchini well or the loaf turns gummy.

recipes.name: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
recipes.description: Chewy oatmeal cookies with raisins and a hint of cinnamon.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line baking sheets.
Cream the butter and brown sugar, then beat in the egg.
Mix in the flour, oats, cinnamon and baking soda.
Fold in the raisins.
Scoop onto the sheets and bake 10–12 minutes.
tips: Pull them when the edges set but the centers still look soft for chewy cookies.

recipes.name: Whole Grain Dinner Rolls
recipes.description: Soft whole-wheat dinner rolls — a wholesome side for soups and roasts.
steps: Stir the yeast and honey into the warm milk and let it foam for 5 minutes.
Mix in the egg, melted butter, salt and flour to form a soft dough.
Knead 8 minutes, then cover and let rise 1 hour until doubled.
Shape into 12 balls, place in a baking dish, and rise 30 minutes.
Bake at 375°F for 18–20 minutes, until golden.
tips: The milk should be warm, not hot, so it doesn't kill the yeast.

recipes.name: Baked Cinnamon Apples
recipes.description: Tender baked apples stuffed with cinnamon, oats and walnuts — dessert that eats like a hug.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Mix the oats, walnuts, maple syrup, cinnamon and coconut oil.
Stuff the mixture into the cored apples and set them in a baking dish.
Add a splash of water to the dish and bake 30 minutes, until soft.
tips: Use a firm baking apple like Honeycrisp or Gala so they hold their shape.

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Almond Bark
recipes.description: Just three ingredients — melted dark chocolate, toasted almonds and flaky sea salt.
steps: Melt the dark chocolate gently in a bowl over simmering water or in short microwave bursts.
Stir in most of the almonds.
Spread on a lined tray and scatter the remaining almonds and the sea salt.
Chill 30 minutes until set, then break into shards.
tips: Use 70%+ dark chocolate for less sugar and more antioxidants.

recipes.name: Frozen Yogurt Berry Bark
recipes.description: Greek yogurt spread thin with berries and granola, frozen into a refreshing snackable bark.
steps: Stir the honey into the Greek yogurt.
Spread it 1/2 inch thick on a lined tray.
Scatter the berries and granola on top.
Freeze 3 hours until firm, then break into pieces.
tips: Keep it frozen and eat within a couple of weeks.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Energy Balls
recipes.description: No-bake oat and peanut butter bites with chia and dark chocolate — a grab-and-go snack.
steps: Stir all the ingredients together until evenly combined.
Chill 20 minutes to firm up.
Roll into 12 balls.
Store in the fridge.
tips: If the mix is too soft to roll, chill longer or add a spoon more oats.

recipes.name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts
recipes.description: Crispy roasted Brussels sprouts with garlic and a balsamic drizzle.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the sprouts with olive oil, garlic, salt and pepper.
Roast cut-side down 20–25 minutes, until crisp and browned.
Drizzle with balsamic vinegar and serve.
tips: Don't crowd the pan — give them room to crisp instead of steam.

recipes.name: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas
recipes.description: Crunchy spiced roasted chickpeas — a high-fiber snack or salad topper.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Pat the chickpeas very dry.
Toss with the olive oil, paprika, cumin and salt.
Roast 25–30 minutes, shaking once, until crunchy.
tips: The drier the chickpeas before roasting, the crispier they get.

recipes.name: Caprese Skewers
recipes.description: Cherry tomato, mozzarella and basil skewers with a balsamic drizzle — a no-cook appetizer.
steps: Thread a cherry tomato, a basil leaf and a mozzarella ball onto each small skewer.
Arrange on a platter.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze, and season with salt and pepper.
tips: Use the smallest mozzarella balls (bocconcini) for easy threading.

recipes.name: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.description: Oven-baked sweet potato fries with smoked paprika — crispier than you'd expect.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the fries with the olive oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake 25–30 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp at the edges.

steps: Simmer dal with turmeric and water until soft.
Temper cumin seeds in a little oil and stir in.
Top with cilantro.

recipes.name: Arepas with Egg
recipes.description: Crispy corn cakes split and stuffed with scrambled egg and cheese.
steps: Mix masarepa, water and salt into a dough and form patties.
Griddle until crisp, then split.
Stuff with egg and cheese.

recipes.name: Miso Soup Breakfast
recipes.description: A warming Japanese breakfast soup with tofu and seaweed.
steps: Warm the dashi and add wakame and tofu.
Whisk in miso off the boil.
Top with scallion.

recipes.name: Avocado Egg Breakfast Bowl
recipes.description: Soft eggs over greens and avocado with a squeeze of lime.
steps: Soft-boil or fry the eggs.
Toss greens with oil and lime.
Top with avocado and eggs.

recipes.name: Breakfast Grain Bowl
recipes.description: Farro with a soft egg, avocado, tomato and greens.
steps: Warm the farro and arrange in a bowl.
Top with arugula, tomato and avocado.
Finish with a soft-cooked egg.

recipes.name: Savory Yogurt Bowl
recipes.description: Tangy yogurt topped with cucumber, olive oil and za'atar.
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with cucumber.
Drizzle oil and sprinkle za'atar and salt.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Bowl
recipes.description: Mashed roasted sweet potato with almond butter, banana and cinnamon.
steps: Mash the warm sweet potato.
Top with banana, almond butter and pecans.
Dust with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Breakfast Burrito Bowl
recipes.description: All the burrito fillings in a bowl over rice — no wrap needed.
steps: Spoon rice into a bowl.
Top with eggs, beans and pico de gallo.
Add avocado.

recipes.name: Breakfast Chia Pudding
recipes.description: Chia soaked in milk overnight into a thick pudding, topped with fruit.
steps: Stir chia, milk, maple and vanilla together.
Refrigerate overnight until thick.
Top with berries.

recipes.name: Creamy Breakfast Polenta
recipes.description: Soft polenta sweetened with maple and topped with berries.
steps: Whisk polenta into simmering milk with salt.
Cook 20 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Sweeten and top with berries.

recipes.name: Breakfast Fruit Salad
recipes.description: A bright bowl of mixed fresh fruit with lime and mint.
steps: Combine all the fruit in a bowl.
Toss with lime juice.
Scatter mint over the top.

recipes.name: Nut Butter Energy Oatmeal
recipes.description: Protein-packed oats with almond butter, chia, banana and hemp seeds.
steps: Cook oats in milk for 5 minutes.
Stir in almond butter and chia.
Top with hemp seeds.

recipes.name: Apple Pie Overnight Oats
recipes.description: No-cook oats with grated apple, cinnamon and walnuts.
steps: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, apple and cinnamon in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with walnuts in the morning.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Spice Oatmeal
recipes.description: Creamy oats stirred with pumpkin purée and warm spice.
steps: Simmer milk and stir in oats and pumpkin.
Cook 5 minutes with the spice.
Sweeten with maple syrup.

recipes.name: Muesli with Yogurt
recipes.description: No-cook toasted muesli layered with yogurt and fruit.
steps: Layer muesli and yogurt in a glass.
Top with raspberries and almonds.
Drizzle honey.

recipes.name: Savory Cottage Cheese Bowl
recipes.description: Cottage cheese with tomato, cucumber, olive oil and black pepper.
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with tomato and cucumber.
Drizzle oil and add pepper.

recipes.name: Scrambled Tofu
recipes.description: A vegan scramble of crumbled tofu with turmeric and veggies.
steps: Sauté pepper, then add crumbled tofu and turmeric.
Cook until golden, fold in spinach.
Stir in nutritional yeast.

recipes.name: Breakfast Couscous
recipes.description: Fluffy couscous with warm milk, dates and pistachios.
steps: Pour hot milk over couscous and cover 5 minutes.
Fluff and stir in dates and cinnamon.
Top with pistachios.

recipes.name: Avocado Feta Toast
recipes.description: Mashed avocado on toast with crumbled feta and chili flakes.
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with lemon and spread.
Top with feta and chili flakes.

recipes.name: Banana Bread Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Overnight oats that taste like banana bread, with walnuts.
steps: Stir oats, milk, banana and cinnamon together.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with walnuts.

recipes.name: Egg & Veggie Scramble Bowl
recipes.description: Scrambled eggs over greens with roasted vegetables.
steps: Scramble the eggs in oil.
Wilt spinach and warm the roasted vegetables.
Combine in a bowl.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
recipes.description: Toasted bagel with cream cheese, smoked salmon, red onion and capers.
steps: Toast the bagel.
Spread with cream cheese.
Layer salmon, onion and capers.

recipes.name: Spinach Frittata Muffins
recipes.description: Mini crustless frittatas with spinach and feta for grab-and-go.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk and pepper; stir in spinach and feta.
Pour into a muffin tin.
Bake at 375°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Matcha Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Creamy overnight oats with matcha and a hint of honey.
steps: Whisk matcha into the milk, then stir in oats, honey and chia.
Refrigerate overnight.
Stir and serve cold.

recipes.name: Shakshuka with Feta
recipes.description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce with crumbled feta.
steps: Sauté onion, add tomatoes and cumin and simmer.
Make wells and crack in the eggs, scatter feta.
Cover and cook until whites set.

recipes.name: PB&J Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Overnight oats layered with peanut butter and berry jam flavors.
steps: Stir oats, milk and honey; swirl in peanut butter.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with mashed berries.

recipes.name: Japanese Breakfast Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Steamed rice with a soft egg, nori and soy — a classic Japanese morning.
steps: Spoon warm rice into bowls.
Top with a soft-cooked egg and nori.
Drizzle soy and add scallion.

recipes.name: Almond Flour Porridge
recipes.description: A warm grain-free, low-carb porridge of almond flour and coconut.
steps: Warm almond milk, whisk in almond flour and chia.
Cook 3–4 minutes until thick.
Top with coconut and maple syrup.

recipes.name: Vegan Tofu Breakfast Burrito
recipes.description: Turmeric tofu scramble with beans and salsa in a warm tortilla.
steps: Warm the tofu scramble and beans.
Fill tortillas with scramble, beans, salsa and avocado.
Roll up and toast seam-down.

recipes.name: Baked Eggs in Tomato Cups
recipes.description: Eggs baked inside hollowed tomatoes with herbs and cheese.
steps: Hollow the tomatoes and set in a baking dish.
Crack an egg into each and top with parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes; garnish with basil.

recipes.name: Protein Yogurt Parfait
recipes.description: Layered Greek yogurt, granola and berries with a scoop of protein.
steps: Stir protein powder into the yogurt.
Layer with granola and berries in a glass.
Drizzle honey.

recipes.name: Egg & Avocado Naan
recipes.description: Warm naan topped with smashed avocado and a fried egg.
steps: Warm the naan.
Smash avocado with lemon over it.
Top with fried eggs and chili flakes.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Breast
recipes.description: Juicy oven-baked chicken breasts with garlic and herbs.
steps: Rub chicken with oil, garlic, thyme and salt.
Bake at 425°F for 22 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas
recipes.description: Sizzling strips of chicken with peppers and onions in warm tortillas.
steps: Toss chicken with seasoning and sear hot.
Add peppers and onion and cook until charred.
Serve in warm tortillas.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken
recipes.description: Glossy teriyaki-glazed chicken over rice.
steps: Sear the chicken until golden.
Add soy, honey and ginger and simmer to a glaze.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.description: Breaded chicken cutlets baked with marinara and mozzarella.
steps: Bread the cutlets in egg and breadcrumbs and pan-fry.
Top with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes until bubbling.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Tender chicken in a creamy spiced tomato sauce.
steps: Sear the chicken, then set aside.
Simmer tomato, garlic and garam masala, stir in cream.
Return chicken and simmer 10 minutes; serve with rice.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp
recipes.description: Quick garlicky shrimp in a bright lemon-butter sauce.
steps: Melt butter and sauté garlic.
Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes until pink.
Finish with lemon and parsley.

recipes.name: Herb-Baked Salmon
recipes.description: Flaky salmon fillets baked with lemon and dill.
steps: Place salmon on a lined tray, drizzle with oil.
Top with lemon and dill.
Bake at 400°F for 14 minutes.

recipes.name: Fish Tacos
recipes.description: Crispy white fish in corn tortillas with slaw and lime crema.
steps: Season and pan-sear the fish, then flake.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with fish, cabbage and crema; squeeze lime.

recipes.name: Shrimp Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Fast shrimp and crisp vegetables in a savory sauce.
steps: Sear shrimp in sesame oil and set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables with ginger.
Return shrimp, add soy sauce and toss.

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Seasoned ground beef in crisp shells with all the toppings.
steps: Brown the beef and stir in seasoning.
Warm the shells.
Fill with beef, lettuce and cheese.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.description: Classic slow-simmered meat sauce over spaghetti.
steps: Brown beef with onion and garlic.
Add tomatoes and simmer 30 minutes.
Serve over cooked spaghetti.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.description: Tender beef and broccoli in a glossy soy-garlic sauce.
steps: Sear the beef and set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli, add sauce and cornstarch slurry.
Return beef and toss until glazed.

recipes.name: Hearty Beef Stew
recipes.description: Slow-simmered beef with potatoes, carrots and rich gravy.
steps: Brown the beef, then add broth and tomato paste.
Simmer 90 minutes.
Add potatoes and carrots and cook 30 minutes more.

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Pork Chops
recipes.description: Golden pork chops with a garlic-butter baste.
steps: Sear chops in oil 4 minutes per side.
Add butter, garlic and rosemary and baste.
Rest before serving.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Pulled Pork
recipes.description: Fall-apart pork shoulder in smoky barbecue sauce.
steps: Rub pork with paprika and set over onion and broth.
Slow-cook 8 hours until tender.
Shred and toss with barbecue sauce.

recipes.name: Baked Ziti
recipes.description: Cheesy baked pasta with marinara and ricotta.
steps: Cook ziti and toss with marinara and ricotta.
Layer in a dish with mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Fettuccine Alfredo
recipes.description: Silky parmesan cream sauce over fettuccine.
steps: Cook the pasta.
Simmer cream, butter and garlic, whisk in parmesan.
Toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Pasta Primavera
recipes.description: Pasta tossed with spring vegetables in a light garlic-oil sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté vegetables in oil and garlic.
Toss together with parmesan.

recipes.name: Pesto Pasta
recipes.description: Pasta coated in fresh basil pesto with cherry tomatoes.
steps: Cook and drain the pasta, reserving a little water.
Toss with pesto and a splash of pasta water.
Fold in tomatoes and parmesan.

recipes.name: Classic Lasagna
recipes.description: Layered pasta with meat sauce, ricotta and mozzarella.
steps: Layer noodles, meat sauce, ricotta and mozzarella.
Repeat and top with parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 45 minutes; rest 15.

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Crisp-tender mixed vegetables in a quick soy-ginger sauce.
steps: Heat sesame oil and add ginger and garlic.
Stir-fry the vegetables until crisp-tender.
Add soy sauce and toss.

recipes.name: Mixed Vegetable Curry
recipes.description: Hearty vegetables simmered in a coconut curry sauce.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic with curry powder.
Add vegetables and coconut milk.
Simmer 20 minutes; serve with rice.

recipes.name: Dal Tadka
recipes.description: Comforting yellow lentils with a sizzling spice tempering.
steps: Simmer lentils with turmeric until soft.
Fry cumin and garlic in ghee or oil.
Pour the tempering over the dal.

recipes.name: Chana Masala
recipes.description: Chickpeas simmered in a tangy spiced tomato gravy.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic, add garam masala.
Add tomato and chickpeas.
Simmer 20 minutes; serve with rice.

recipes.name: Black Bean Burrito Bowl
recipes.description: Rice bowl with black beans, corn, avocado and salsa.
steps: Spoon rice into bowls.
Top with beans, corn and salsa.
Add avocado.

recipes.name: Buddha Bowl
recipes.description: A balanced bowl of grains, roasted veg, chickpeas and tahini.
steps: Arrange quinoa, kale, vegetables and chickpeas in a bowl.
Drizzle with tahini dressing.
Toss before eating.

recipes.name: Falafel Bowl
recipes.description: Crispy falafel over greens with hummus and tahini.
steps: Warm or fry the falafel.
Build a bowl of greens, cucumber and hummus.
Top with falafel and tahini.

recipes.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.description: Peppers baked with a savory rice-and-beef filling.
steps: Brown beef and mix with rice and tomato sauce.
Stuff the peppers and top with cheese.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Eggplant Parmesan
recipes.description: Breaded eggplant baked with marinara and mozzarella.
steps: Bread and bake the eggplant slices until golden.
Layer with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
recipes.description: A rustic Provençal stew of summer vegetables.
steps: Sauté each vegetable in oil, then combine.
Add tomatoes and herbs.
Simmer 40 minutes until thick.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken & Veggies
recipes.description: Chicken thighs and vegetables roasted on one pan.
steps: Toss chicken and vegetables with oil and seasoning.
Spread on a sheet pan.
Roast at 425°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Baked Turkey Meatballs
recipes.description: Lean turkey meatballs baked and simmered in marinara.
steps: Mix turkey, breadcrumbs, egg and parmesan and roll into balls.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.
Simmer in marinara 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Comforting chicken soup with vegetables and egg noodles.
steps: Simmer broth with carrots and celery.
Add noodles and cook until tender.
Stir in the chicken and heat through.

recipes.name: Minestrone Soup
recipes.description: A hearty Italian vegetable and bean soup with pasta.
steps: Simmer broth, tomatoes and vegetables.
Add beans and pasta.
Cook until pasta is tender.

recipes.name: Tomato Basil Soup
recipes.description: Velvety roasted tomato soup with fresh basil.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic, add tomatoes and simmer.
Blend smooth and stir in cream.
Finish with basil.

recipes.name: Butternut Squash Soup
recipes.description: Creamy roasted butternut squash soup with warming spice.
steps: Roast or simmer the squash with onion and broth.
Blend smooth with coconut milk.
Season with nutmeg.

recipes.name: New England Clam Chowder
recipes.description: Creamy potato chowder studded with clams.
steps: Crisp the bacon, then sauté onion.
Add potatoes and clam juice and simmer.
Stir in clams and milk; heat through.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Crisp romaine with grilled chicken, parmesan and croutons.
steps: Toss romaine with dressing.
Top with chicken, parmesan and croutons.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Cobb Salad
recipes.description: A composed salad of chicken, egg, bacon, avocado and blue cheese.
steps: Arrange lettuce on a platter.
Top in rows with chicken, egg, avocado, bacon and blue cheese.
Drizzle with dressing.

recipes.name: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Tomato, cucumber, olives and feta with oregano and olive oil.
steps: Combine tomato, cucumber, onion and olives.
Top with feta.
Dress with olive oil and oregano.

recipes.name: Niçoise Salad
recipes.description: A French composed salad with tuna, egg, green beans and potatoes.
steps: Arrange greens, beans and potatoes on a platter.
Top with tuna, egg and olives.
Drizzle with vinaigrette.

recipes.name: Salmon Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Flaky salmon over rice with avocado, cucumber and soy.
steps: Bake or pan-sear the salmon and flake.
Spoon rice into bowls.
Top with salmon, avocado and cucumber; drizzle soy.

recipes.name: Tuna Poke Bowl
recipes.description: Marinated raw tuna over rice with edamame and avocado.
steps: Toss tuna with soy sauce.
Spoon rice into bowls and top with tuna.
Add edamame and avocado.

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi
recipes.description: Garlicky shrimp in white wine butter over linguine.
steps: Cook the linguine.
Sauté garlic in butter, add shrimp and wine.
Toss with the pasta and parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken Pad Thai
recipes.description: Stir-fried rice noodles with chicken, egg and a tangy tamarind sauce.
steps: Soak the noodles.
Stir-fry chicken, push aside and scramble eggs.
Add noodles and sauce, toss; top with peanuts.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry
recipes.description: Fragrant green curry with chicken and vegetables in coconut milk.
steps: Fry the curry paste, add coconut milk.
Add chicken and vegetables.
Simmer 20 minutes; serve with rice.

recipes.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
recipes.description: Wok-fried day-old rice with egg and mixed vegetables.
steps: Scramble the eggs and set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables, add rice and soy.
Fold in egg and finish with sesame oil.

recipes.name: Classic Beef Burger
recipes.description: A juicy grilled beef burger with all the fixings.
steps: Form patties and grill 4 minutes per side.
Melt cheese on top.
Build burgers on toasted buns with lettuce and tomato.

recipes.name: Turkey Burger
recipes.description: Lean seasoned turkey burgers on toasted buns.
steps: Mix turkey with garlic powder and form patties.
Grill 5 minutes per side.
Serve on buns with lettuce and tomato.

recipes.name: Black Bean Burger
recipes.description: A hearty vegetarian burger from mashed black beans and oats.
steps: Mix beans, oats, egg and cumin and form patties.
Pan-fry 4 minutes per side.
Serve on buns with toppings.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma
recipes.description: Spiced roasted chicken wrapped with garlic sauce and veg.
steps: Toss chicken with spice and roast at 425°F for 30 minutes.
Slice thin.
Wrap in pita with garlic sauce and salad.

recipes.name: Greek Gyro Bowl
recipes.description: Seasoned pork or chicken over rice with tzatziki and salad.
steps: Warm the gyro meat.
Build bowls of rice, salad and meat.
Top with tzatziki and feta.

recipes.name: Stuffed Zucchini Boats
recipes.description: Hollowed zucchini filled with turkey, tomato and cheese.
steps: Scoop out the zucchini and brown turkey with garlic and marinara.
Fill the boats and top with cheese.
Bake at 400°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Shepherd's Pie
recipes.description: Savory lamb and vegetables under a mashed potato crust.
steps: Brown lamb with onion and tomato paste, add vegetables.
Top with mashed potatoes.
Bake at 400°F for 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Chicken Pot Pie
recipes.description: Creamy chicken and vegetables under a flaky pastry lid.
steps: Stir chicken and vegetables into the gravy.
Pour into a dish and cover with crust, brush with egg.
Bake at 400°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Classic Meatloaf
recipes.description: A homestyle beef meatloaf with a tangy glaze.
steps: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg and onion and shape into a loaf.
Top with ketchup.
Bake at 375°F for 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Pork Lo Mein
recipes.description: Stir-fried noodles with pork and vegetables in a savory sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles.
Stir-fry pork and vegetables.
Add noodles and soy sauce and toss.

recipes.name: Coconut Shrimp Curry
recipes.description: Shrimp simmered in a fragrant coconut tomato curry.
steps: Sauté onion with curry powder.
Add tomato and coconut milk and simmer.
Add shrimp and cook 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Crispy Tofu Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Golden tofu and vegetables in a sticky soy-garlic glaze.
steps: Crisp the tofu, then set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables and garlic.
Add tofu, soy and cornstarch slurry; toss to glaze.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Creamy arborio rice slowly cooked with mushrooms and parmesan.
steps: Sauté onion and mushrooms.
Add rice and ladle in broth gradually, stirring.
Finish with parmesan.

recipes.name: Vegetable Lasagna
recipes.description: Layered pasta with roasted vegetables, ricotta and marinara.
steps: Layer noodles, vegetables, ricotta and marinara.
Repeat and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F for 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Chili con Carne
recipes.description: A rich beef-and-bean chili spiced with cumin and chili powder.
steps: Brown beef with onion.
Add tomatoes, beans and spices.
Simmer 40 minutes.

recipes.name: White Chicken Chili
recipes.description: Creamy chili with chicken, white beans and green chilies.
steps: Simmer chicken, beans, broth and chilies.
Stir in sour cream.
Cook 15 minutes until creamy.

recipes.name: Baked Cod with Tomatoes
recipes.description: Tender cod baked with cherry tomatoes, olives and herbs.
steps: Place cod in a baking dish with tomatoes and olives.
Drizzle with oil and garlic.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Seared Scallops
recipes.description: Golden-crusted scallops in lemon butter.
steps: Pat scallops dry and sear in oil 2 minutes per side.
Add butter and lemon and baste.
Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Tender chicken and vegetables in a quick savory sauce.
steps: Sear the chicken and set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables with ginger.
Return chicken, add soy and toss.

recipes.name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
recipes.description: A vegan twist on the classic with lentils under mashed potato.
steps: Cook lentils with onion, vegetables and tomato paste.
Top with mashed potatoes.
Bake at 400°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Salmon
recipes.description: Glazed salmon fillets with a sweet-savory teriyaki sauce.
steps: Simmer soy, honey, ginger and vinegar to a glaze.
Sear salmon, then brush with glaze.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Caprese Chicken
recipes.description: Pan-seared chicken topped with tomato, mozzarella and basil.
steps: Sear the chicken until cooked through.
Top with tomato and mozzarella and melt under a lid.
Finish with basil and balsamic.

recipes.name: Eggplant Curry
recipes.description: Silky eggplant simmered in a spiced tomato-coconut sauce.
steps: Brown the eggplant, then set aside.
Simmer onion, curry, tomato and coconut milk.
Return eggplant and cook 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Beef Kebabs
recipes.description: Marinated beef skewers grilled with peppers and onion.
steps: Marinate beef in oil and lemon.
Thread onto skewers with peppers and onion.
Grill 10–12 minutes, turning.

recipes.name: Chicken Quesadilla
recipes.description: Griddled tortillas stuffed with chicken, cheese and peppers.
steps: Fill a tortilla with chicken, cheese and peppers.
Top with another and griddle in butter.
Flip until golden; slice into wedges.

recipes.name: Salmon Quinoa Bowl
recipes.description: Flaked salmon over quinoa with greens and avocado.
steps: Bake the salmon and flake.
Build bowls of quinoa, spinach and avocado.
Top with salmon and vinaigrette.

recipes.name: Vegetable Paella
recipes.description: Saffron rice with peppers, peas, artichokes and tomatoes.
steps: Sauté the peppers, add rice and saffron.
Pour in broth and arrange peas and artichokes.
Simmer undisturbed 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Thai Basil Chicken
recipes.description: Fiery stir-fried minced chicken with basil over rice.
steps: Stir-fry garlic and chicken until browned.
Add soy and fish sauce.
Toss in basil until wilted; serve over rice.

recipes.name: Baked Feta Pasta
recipes.description: The viral dish — feta and tomatoes roasted into a creamy pasta sauce.
steps: Roast feta, tomatoes, garlic and oil at 400°F for 30 minutes.
Cook the pasta.
Mash and toss everything together.

recipes.name: Turkey Lettuce Wraps
recipes.description: Savory minced turkey with water chestnuts in crisp lettuce cups.
steps: Stir-fry turkey with garlic.
Add water chestnuts and hoisin.
Spoon into lettuce cups.

recipes.name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
recipes.description: Warmly spiced chickpeas and vegetables with apricots.
steps: Sauté onion with the spice blend.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas and apricots.
Simmer 25 minutes; serve over couscous.

recipes.name: Blackened Fish
recipes.description: Spice-crusted fish fillets seared dark and served with lime.
steps: Coat fish in seasoning.
Sear in oil and butter 3 minutes per side.
Serve with lime.

recipes.name: Garden Vegetable Frittata
recipes.description: A big baked frittata loaded with vegetables — dinner or brunch.
steps: Sauté the vegetables in an ovenproof pan.
Add whisked eggs, milk and cheese.
Bake at 375°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Braised Short Ribs
recipes.description: Fall-off-the-bone beef short ribs braised in red wine.
steps: Sear the ribs, then sauté onion and tomato paste.
Add wine and broth.
Braise covered at 325°F for 3 hours.

recipes.name: Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
recipes.description: Meaty portobello caps filled with spinach, garlic and cheese.
steps: Wilt spinach with garlic and mix with breadcrumbs.
Fill the caps and top with cheese.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Gyro Wrap
recipes.description: Spiced chicken wrapped in pita with tzatziki and salad.
steps: Sear the seasoned chicken.
Warm the pita.
Fill with chicken, tzatziki, tomato and onion.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Chickpea Curry
recipes.description: Sweet potato and chickpeas in a creamy spiced coconut sauce.
steps: Simmer sweet potato in coconut milk with curry.
Add chickpeas and cook until tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted.

recipes.name: Philly Cheesesteak
recipes.description: Thin-sliced beef with peppers, onions and melted cheese on a hoagie.
steps: Sear the beef with onion and pepper.
Top with provolone to melt.
Pile into toasted rolls.

recipes.name: Tuna Melt
recipes.description: Creamy tuna salad and cheddar grilled on toast.
steps: Mix tuna with mayonnaise.
Pile onto bread with cheese.
Griddle in butter until golden and melty.

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.description: Spicy stir-fried chicken with peanuts and dried chilies.
steps: Stir-fry chicken with the chilies.
Add soy and vinegar.
Toss in peanuts; serve over rice.

recipes.name: Zucchini Lasagna
recipes.description: A low-carb lasagna using zucchini slices instead of pasta.
steps: Layer zucchini, meat sauce, ricotta and mozzarella.
Repeat and top with parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 35 minutes; rest before slicing.

recipes.name: Salmon Cakes
recipes.description: Pan-fried salmon patties with herbs and a crisp crust.
steps: Mix salmon, breadcrumbs, egg and dill and form patties.
Pan-fry in oil 3 minutes per side.
Serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Vegetable Enchiladas
recipes.description: Rolled tortillas filled with beans and vegetables under red sauce.
steps: Fill tortillas with beans and vegetables and roll.
Place seam-down, cover with sauce and cheese.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Orange Chicken
recipes.description: Crispy chicken in a sticky sweet-tangy orange sauce.
steps: Coat and fry the chicken until crisp.
Simmer orange juice, soy and honey with cornstarch.
Toss chicken in the sauce; serve over rice.

recipes.name: Greek Stuffed Peppers
recipes.description: Peppers baked with herbed rice, tomato and feta.
steps: Mix rice, tomato, feta and dill.
Stuff the peppers.
Bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Tzatziki
recipes.description: Cool Greek yogurt dip with cucumber, garlic and dill.
steps: Squeeze excess water from the grated cucumber.
Stir everything together.
Chill 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Baba Ganoush
recipes.description: Smoky roasted eggplant dip with tahini and lemon.
steps: Roast the eggplants until collapsed, then scoop the flesh.
Blend with tahini, lemon and garlic.
Drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.name: Pico de Gallo
recipes.description: Fresh chopped salsa of tomato, onion, cilantro and lime.
steps: Combine all the ingredients.
Season with salt.
Let sit 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Spinach Artichoke Dip
recipes.description: Warm, cheesy spinach and artichoke dip for chips or bread.
steps: Mix all the ingredients in a baking dish.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.
Serve hot and bubbly.

recipes.name: Queso Dip
recipes.description: Creamy melted cheese dip with green chilies.
steps: Warm milk and whisk in cheese tossed with cornstarch.
Stir in chilies and cumin.
Serve warm with chips.

recipes.name: White Bean Dip
recipes.description: Silky cannellini bean dip with garlic, lemon and rosemary.
steps: Blend the beans with oil, lemon and garlic.
Stir in rosemary.
Drizzle with more oil to serve.

recipes.name: Beet Hummus
recipes.description: Vivid pink hummus from roasted beet and chickpeas.
steps: Blend chickpeas, beet, tahini, lemon and garlic until smooth.
Thin with water as needed.
Drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Dip
recipes.description: Spicy, creamy shredded chicken dip with hot sauce and cheese.
steps: Mix all the ingredients in a baking dish.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.
Serve hot with celery and chips.

recipes.name: Chunky Guacamole
recipes.description: Chunky avocado dip with lime, onion and cilantro.
steps: Mash the avocados to a chunky texture.
Fold in onion, lime, cilantro and salt.
Serve right away.

recipes.name: Roasted Asparagus
recipes.description: Tender-crisp asparagus roasted with garlic and parmesan.
steps: Toss asparagus with oil, garlic and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 12 minutes.
Top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Honey Roasted Carrots
recipes.description: Sweet glazed carrots roasted until caramelized.
steps: Toss carrots with oil, honey and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Sprinkle with thyme.

recipes.name: Roasted Cauliflower
recipes.description: Golden cauliflower florets roasted with cumin.
steps: Toss cauliflower with oil and spices.
Spread on a tray.
Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Garlic Green Beans
recipes.description: Crisp sautéed green beans with garlic and lemon.
steps: Blanch the green beans 3 minutes.
Sauté with garlic in oil.
Finish with lemon and salt.

recipes.name: Roasted Beets
recipes.description: Earthy roasted beets with olive oil and balsamic.
steps: Toss beets with oil, balsamic and salt.
Roast at 400°F for 35 minutes.
Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipes.description: Creamy mashed potatoes with roasted garlic and butter.
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender and drain.
Mash with milk, butter and garlic.
Season with salt.

recipes.name: Classic Coleslaw
recipes.description: Crunchy cabbage slaw in a creamy tangy dressing.
steps: Combine cabbage and carrot.
Whisk mayo, vinegar and sugar.
Toss and chill 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Potato Salad
recipes.description: Creamy potato salad with egg, celery and mustard.
steps: Combine potatoes, eggs and celery.
Fold in mayo and mustard.
Chill before serving.

recipes.name: Italian Pasta Salad
recipes.description: Cold pasta tossed with vegetables, salami and Italian dressing.
steps: Combine pasta, tomatoes, salami and mozzarella.
Toss with dressing.
Chill before serving.

recipes.name: Cucumber Salad
recipes.description: Crisp cucumber and onion in a light vinegar dressing.
steps: Combine cucumber and onion.
Toss with vinegar and sugar.
Chill 20 minutes; add dill.

recipes.name: Three Bean Salad
recipes.description: Marinated kidney, garbanzo and green beans in tangy dressing.
steps: Combine the beans and onion.
Toss with vinaigrette.
Marinate 1 hour.

recipes.name: Broccoli Salad
recipes.description: Crunchy raw broccoli with bacon, cranberries and a creamy dressing.
steps: Combine broccoli, cranberries, bacon and seeds.
Toss with dressing.
Chill before serving.

recipes.name: Carrot Raisin Salad
recipes.description: Sweet shredded carrot salad with raisins and a creamy dressing.
steps: Combine carrot and raisins.
Toss with mayo, lemon and honey.
Chill before serving.

recipes.name: Homemade Trail Mix
recipes.description: A grab-and-go mix of nuts, seeds, dried fruit and dark chocolate.
steps: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl.
Toss to mix.
Store in an airtight jar.

recipes.name: Kale Chips
recipes.description: Crispy oven-baked kale with sea salt.
steps: Massage kale with oil and salt.
Spread on a tray in a single layer.
Bake at 300°F for 15 minutes; dust with nutritional yeast.

recipes.name: Stovetop Popcorn
recipes.description: Freshly popped popcorn with butter and salt.
steps: Heat oil and kernels in a covered pot, shaking.
Pop until gaps slow.
Toss with butter and salt.

recipes.name: Deviled Eggs
recipes.description: Classic deviled eggs with a creamy mustard filling.
steps: Halve the eggs and mash the yolks with mayo and mustard.
Pipe back into the whites.
Dust with paprika and chives.

recipes.name: Stuffed Dates
recipes.description: Medjool dates filled with almond butter and topped with sea salt.
steps: Pit the dates and fill with almond butter.
Top with pistachios.
Sprinkle with sea salt.

recipes.name: Rosemary Roasted Nuts
recipes.description: Warm spiced roasted nuts with rosemary and sea salt.
steps: Toss nuts with oil, rosemary, salt and cayenne.
Spread on a tray.
Roast at 350°F for 12 minutes.

recipes.name: Garlic Edamame
recipes.description: Steamed edamame tossed with garlic and sea salt.
steps: Steam the edamame 5 minutes.
Toss with sesame oil, garlic and salt.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Baked Zucchini Fries
recipes.description: Crispy breaded zucchini sticks baked golden.
steps: Dip zucchini in egg, then breadcrumb-parmesan mix.
Arrange on a tray.
Bake at 425°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Polenta Fries
recipes.description: Crispy baked fries cut from set polenta.
steps: Spread polenta to set, then cut into sticks.
Toss with oil, paprika and salt.
Bake at 425°F for 25 minutes; top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Baked Carrot Fries
recipes.description: Sweet roasted carrot sticks with a hint of garlic.
steps: Toss carrots with oil, garlic powder and salt.
Spread on a tray.
Roast at 425°F for 22 minutes; garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Rice Pilaf
recipes.description: Fluffy rice toasted and simmered with onion and herbs.
steps: Sauté onion in butter, add rice and toast.
Add broth and simmer covered 18 minutes.
Fluff and add parsley.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Couscous Salad
recipes.description: Couscous with cucumber, tomato, feta and lemon.
steps: Combine couscous, cucumber and tomato.
Add feta and vinaigrette.
Toss and chill.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
recipes.description: Sliced tomato and fresh mozzarella with basil and balsamic.
steps: Alternate tomato and mozzarella on a plate.
Tuck in basil leaves.
Drizzle with oil and balsamic.

recipes.name: Roasted Okra
recipes.description: Crispy roasted okra with paprika — no slime.
steps: Toss okra with oil and spices.
Spread cut-side down on a tray.
Roast at 450°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Garlic Sautéed Mushrooms
recipes.description: Buttery mushrooms with garlic and thyme.
steps: Sear mushrooms in butter until golden.
Add garlic and thyme.
Season and serve.

recipes.name: Creamed Spinach
recipes.description: Rich, velvety spinach in a parmesan cream sauce.
steps: Wilt spinach, then squeeze and chop.
Make a garlic cream sauce with butter and parmesan.
Fold in the spinach.

recipes.name: Grilled Corn on the Cob
recipes.description: Charred sweet corn with herb butter.
steps: Grill the corn, turning, until charred.
Slather with herb butter.
Serve with lime and salt.

recipes.name: Crispy Roasted Potatoes
recipes.description: Golden, crunchy roasted baby potatoes with rosemary.
steps: Parboil 8 minutes and drain.
Toss with oil, rosemary, garlic and salt.
Roast at 450°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Baked Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: Creamy baked macaroni with a golden cheddar top.
steps: Make a roux with butter and flour, whisk in milk and cheese.
Toss with cooked macaroni.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
recipes.description: Smooth chickpea hummus blended with sweet roasted peppers.
steps: Blend chickpeas, peppers, tahini, lemon and garlic.
Thin with water to taste.
Drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.name: Stuffed Mini Peppers
recipes.description: Sweet mini peppers filled with herbed cream cheese.
steps: Mix cream cheese with chives, garlic and pepper.
Fill the pepper halves.
Serve chilled or bake at 375°F for 12 minutes.

recipes.name: Tomato Bruschetta
recipes.description: Toasted bread topped with marinated tomato and basil.
steps: Toast the baguette slices and rub with garlic.
Toss tomato, basil and oil.
Spoon onto the toasts.

recipes.name: Garlic Bread
recipes.description: Crusty bread baked with garlic butter and parsley.
steps: Mix butter, garlic and parsley and spread on the bread.
Top with parmesan.
Bake at 400°F for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Crispy Avocado Fries
recipes.description: Breaded avocado wedges baked until crisp.
steps: Dredge avocado in flour, egg and panko.
Arrange on a tray.
Bake at 425°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate Energy Balls
recipes.description: No-bake oat and cocoa bites with dates and nut butter.
steps: Mix everything into a sticky dough.
Roll into balls.
Chill 30 minutes to set.

recipes.name: Apple Nachos
recipes.description: Sliced apples drizzled with nut butter and topped with goodies.
steps: Fan the apple slices on a plate.
Drizzle with peanut butter.
Scatter chocolate, nuts and coconut.

recipes.name: Frozen Yogurt Bark
recipes.description: Frozen sheet of yogurt studded with berries and granola.
steps: Mix yogurt with honey and spread on a lined tray.
Scatter berries, granola and chia.
Freeze 3 hours, then break into pieces.

recipes.name: Snack Cheese & Olive Plate
recipes.description: A simple protein snack plate of cheese, olives and nuts.
steps: Arrange cheese, olives and almonds on a board.
Add grapes and crackers.
Serve.

recipes.name: Spiced Roasted Chickpeas
recipes.description: Crunchy oven-roasted chickpeas with smoked paprika.
steps: Pat chickpeas dry and toss with oil and spices.
Spread on a tray.
Roast at 425°F for 30 minutes until crisp.

recipes.name: Veggie Sticks with Ranch
recipes.description: Crunchy raw vegetables with a creamy yogurt ranch dip.
steps: Cut the vegetables into sticks.
Stir ranch seasoning into the yogurt.
Serve with the dip.

recipes.name: Cherry Caprese Skewers
recipes.description: Mini skewers of tomato, mozzarella and basil with balsamic.
steps: Thread tomato, mozzarella and basil onto skewers.
Arrange on a plate.
Drizzle with oil and balsamic.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Wedges
recipes.description: Roasted sweet potato wedges with paprika and a crisp edge.
steps: Toss wedges with oil and spices.
Spread in a single layer.
Roast at 425°F for 30 minutes, flipping once.

recipes.name: Loaded Baked Potato
recipes.description: Fluffy baked potato topped with cheese, bacon and chives.
steps: Bake potatoes at 400°F for 60 minutes.
Split and fluff the insides.
Top with cheese, bacon, sour cream and chives.

recipes.name: Balsamic Brussels Sprouts
recipes.description: Roasted Brussels sprouts glazed with balsamic.
steps: Toss sprouts with oil and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 22 minutes.
Drizzle with balsamic and honey.

recipes.name: Baked Zucchini Chips
recipes.description: Thin crispy baked zucchini rounds with parmesan.
steps: Toss zucchini with oil and seasoning.
Arrange in a single layer.
Bake at 225°F for 90 minutes until crisp; top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Avocado Deviled Eggs
recipes.description: Deviled eggs with a creamy guacamole-style filling.
steps: Halve eggs and mash yolks with avocado and lime.
Pipe back into the whites.
Top with cilantro.

recipes.name: Chili Lime Popcorn
recipes.description: Popcorn tossed with chili, lime and salt.
steps: Drizzle popcorn with butter and lime.
Sprinkle with chili and salt.
Toss to coat.

recipes.name: Antipasto Skewers
recipes.description: Skewers of salami, mozzarella, olives and tomato.
steps: Thread salami, mozzarella, tomato and olive onto skewers.
Arrange on a platter.
Drizzle with dressing.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Toast
recipes.description: Toasted sweet potato slabs topped with avocado.
steps: Toast the sweet potato slices until tender.
Top with mashed avocado and lime.
Season with chili and salt.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Herb Dip
recipes.description: A light, tangy herb dip for vegetables and chips.
steps: Stir all the ingredients together.
Season with salt.
Chill before serving.

recipes.name: Roasted Acorn Squash
recipes.description: Sweet roasted acorn squash wedges with maple and cinnamon.
steps: Toss squash with oil, maple, cinnamon and salt.
Spread on a tray.
Roast at 400°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Caprese Stuffed Tomatoes
recipes.description: Tomatoes filled with mozzarella, basil and balsamic.
steps: Hollow the tomatoes.
Fill with mozzarella and basil.
Drizzle with oil and balsamic.

recipes.name: Roasted Butternut Squash
recipes.description: Caramelized butternut cubes with sage.
steps: Toss squash with oil, sage, salt and pepper.
Spread on a tray.
Roast at 425°F for 28 minutes.

recipes.name: Banana Nut Butter Bites
recipes.description: Banana coins topped with nut butter and dark chocolate, frozen.
steps: Top each banana coin with peanut butter.
Add chocolate and peanuts.
Freeze 1 hour.

recipes.name: Whipped Cottage Cheese Dip
recipes.description: High-protein whipped cottage cheese dip with herbs.
steps: Blend cottage cheese, oil, garlic and lemon until smooth.
Stir in dill.
Serve with vegetables.

recipes.name: Miso Glazed Eggplant
recipes.description: Roasted eggplant brushed with a sweet-savory miso glaze.
steps: Score and roast the eggplant 20 minutes.
Brush with miso, mirin and honey and roast 10 more.
Sprinkle sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Roasted Radishes
recipes.description: Roasting mellows radishes into a buttery, tender side.
steps: Toss radishes with butter, garlic and salt.
Spread on a tray.
Roast at 425°F for 20 minutes; add parsley.

recipes.name: Lemon Quinoa Salad
recipes.description: Fluffy quinoa with cucumber, herbs and lemon dressing.
steps: Combine quinoa, cucumber and parsley.
Whisk oil and lemon and toss in.
Chill before serving.

recipes.name: Baked Brie with Honey
recipes.description: Warm gooey brie topped with honey and walnuts.
steps: Bake the brie at 350°F for 12 minutes until soft.
Top with honey, walnuts and cranberries.
Serve with baguette.

recipes.name: Spicy Eggplant Dip
recipes.description: Roasted eggplant blended with chili, garlic and tahini.
steps: Roast and scoop the eggplant.
Blend with tahini, harissa, garlic and lemon.
Drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.name: Roasted Fennel
recipes.description: Sweet caramelized fennel wedges with parmesan.
steps: Toss fennel with oil, salt and pepper.
Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Chickpea Snack Salad
recipes.description: A quick no-cook chickpea salad with cucumber, tomato and feta.
steps: Combine chickpeas, cucumber and tomato.
Add feta and vinaigrette.
Toss and serve.

recipes.name: Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms
recipes.description: Button mushrooms filled with garlic-herb cheese and breadcrumbs.
steps: Remove stems and mix with cream cheese, garlic and breadcrumbs.
Fill the caps.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Roasted Garlic Spread
recipes.description: Sweet, mellow roasted garlic mashed into a spread for bread.
steps: Drizzle garlic heads with oil and roast at 400°F for 40 minutes.
Squeeze out the soft cloves and mash with salt and thyme.
Spread on toasted baguette.

recipes.name: Watermelon Feta Bites
recipes.description: Sweet-savory cubes of watermelon, feta and mint.
steps: Skewer or stack watermelon, feta and mint.
Drizzle with oil and balsamic.
Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Baked Tortilla Chips
recipes.description: Crispy homemade tortilla chips with lime and salt.
steps: Toss tortilla wedges with oil and lime.
Spread on trays.
Bake at 375°F for 12 minutes; season with salt and chili.

recipes.name: Honey Roasted Parsnips
recipes.description: Sweet, golden roasted parsnips with thyme.
steps: Toss parsnips with oil, honey and salt.
Spread on a tray.
Roast at 425°F for 28 minutes; add thyme.

recipes.name: Smashed Cucumber Salad
recipes.description: Crunchy smashed cucumbers in a garlicky sesame-soy dressing.
steps: Smash and roughly chop the cucumbers.
Toss with soy, vinegar, sesame oil and garlic.
Chill 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Pesto Deviled Eggs
recipes.description: Deviled eggs with basil pesto folded into the yolk filling.
steps: Mash yolks with mayo and pesto.
Pipe into the whites.
Top with pine nuts.

recipes.name: Roasted Broccolini
recipes.description: Tender broccolini roasted with garlic and lemon.
steps: Toss broccolini with oil and garlic.
Roast at 425°F for 14 minutes.
Finish with lemon and chili flakes.

recipes.name: Loaded Hummus Plate
recipes.description: A bowl of hummus topped with chickpeas, olive oil and paprika.
steps: Spread hummus in a shallow bowl.
Top with chickpeas, oil, paprika and parsley.
Serve with pita.

recipes.name: Frozen Yogurt Grapes
recipes.description: Grapes coated in yogurt and frozen into a poppable snack.
steps: Stir honey into the yogurt and coat the grapes.
Roll in crushed granola.
Freeze on a tray for 2 hours.

recipes.name: Garlic Parmesan Cauliflower
recipes.description: Roasted cauliflower tossed in garlic butter and parmesan.
steps: Toss cauliflower with garlic butter.
Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Toss with parmesan and parsley.

recipes.name: Turmeric Roasted Cauliflower
recipes.description: Golden anti-inflammatory cauliflower with turmeric and cumin.
steps: Toss cauliflower with oil and spices.
Spread on a tray.
Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Greek Lemon Potatoes
recipes.description: Tangy oven-roasted lemon-garlic potato wedges.
steps: Toss potatoes with oil, lemon, garlic and oregano.
Spread in a baking dish.
Roast at 425°F for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Avocado Caprese Salad
recipes.description: Tomato, mozzarella and avocado with basil and balsamic.
steps: Layer tomato, mozzarella and avocado.
Tuck in basil.
Drizzle with balsamic.

recipes.name: Maple Cinnamon Almonds
recipes.description: Sweet roasted almonds glazed with maple and cinnamon.
steps: Toss almonds with maple, cinnamon, salt and nutmeg.
Spread on a lined tray.
Bake at 325°F for 18 minutes; cool to crisp.

recipes.name: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites
recipes.description: Crispy roasted cauliflower tossed in tangy buffalo sauce.
steps: Coat cauliflower in a flour-water batter and roast 20 minutes.
Toss with buffalo sauce and butter.
Roast 10 more minutes.

recipes.name: Savory Cottage Cheese Snack Bowl
recipes.description: High-protein cottage cheese with tomato, cucumber and everything seasoning.
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with tomato and cucumber.
Drizzle oil and add seasoning.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Chewy classic cookies loaded with chocolate chips.
steps: Cream butter and sugar, beat in eggs.
Mix in flour, then fold in chocolate chips.
Bake at 375°F for 11 minutes.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Cookies
recipes.description: Soft, nutty cookies with the classic crosshatch.
steps: Mix all the ingredients into a dough.
Roll into balls and press with a fork.
Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Snickerdoodles
recipes.description: Soft cinnamon-sugar cookies with a tangy hint.
steps: Cream butter and sugar, beat in eggs, then mix in flour.
Roll dough balls in cinnamon sugar.
Bake at 375°F for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Sugar Cookies
recipes.description: Tender cut-out sugar cookies ready for icing.
steps: Cream butter and sugar, add egg and vanilla.
Mix in flour, chill, roll and cut shapes.
Bake at 350°F for 9 minutes.

recipes.name: Oatmeal Cookies
recipes.description: Hearty oat cookies with a chewy center.
steps: Cream butter and sugar, beat in egg.
Mix in flour and oats.
Bake at 350°F for 12 minutes.

recipes.name: Double Chocolate Cookies
recipes.description: Rich cocoa cookies studded with chocolate chips.
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Mix in flour and cocoa, fold in chips.
Bake at 350°F for 11 minutes.

recipes.name: Shortbread Cookies
recipes.description: Buttery, crumbly Scottish shortbread with just three ingredients.
steps: Cream butter and sugar, mix in flour and salt.
Press into a pan and score.
Bake at 325°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Gingerbread Cookies
recipes.description: Spiced molasses cookies perfect for cutting into shapes.
steps: Cream butter, sugar and molasses.
Mix in flour and ginger, chill, roll and cut.
Bake at 350°F for 9 minutes.

recipes.name: Fudge Brownies
recipes.description: Dense, fudgy chocolate brownies with a crackly top.
steps: Whisk melted butter, sugar and eggs.
Fold in flour and cocoa.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Blondies
recipes.description: Chewy brown-sugar bars with white chocolate chips.
steps: Whisk butter, sugar and egg.
Fold in flour and chips.
Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Lemon Bars
recipes.description: Tangy lemon curd over a buttery shortbread crust.
steps: Press flour, butter and 1/4 cup sugar into a crust and bake 18 minutes.
Whisk eggs, sugar and lemon and pour over.
Bake at 350°F for 22 minutes; dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Rice Krispie Treats
recipes.description: Gooey no-bake marshmallow and cereal bars.
steps: Melt butter and marshmallows.
Stir in cereal and salt.
Press into a pan and cool.

recipes.name: Chocolate Pudding
recipes.description: Silky homemade chocolate pudding.
steps: Whisk milk, sugar, cocoa and cornstarch over heat.
Cook until thick, stir in vanilla.
Chill before serving.

recipes.name: Rice Pudding
recipes.description: Creamy cinnamon rice pudding simmered slow.
steps: Simmer rice, milk and sugar, stirring.
Cook 25 minutes until creamy.
Stir in cinnamon and raisins.

recipes.name: Bread Pudding
recipes.description: Warm custard-soaked bread baked with cinnamon.
steps: Whisk milk, eggs, sugar and cinnamon and pour over the bread.
Soak 15 minutes.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Vanilla Panna Cotta
recipes.description: Silky Italian cream custard set with a touch of gelatin.
steps: Bloom gelatin in water.
Warm cream, sugar and vanilla; stir in gelatin.
Pour into molds and chill 4 hours.

recipes.name: Crème Brûlée
recipes.description: Rich vanilla custard under a crackly caramelized sugar top.
steps: Whisk yolks, sugar and warm cream, pour into ramekins.
Bake in a water bath at 325°F for 35 minutes; chill.
Sprinkle sugar and torch until caramelized.

recipes.name: Flan
recipes.description: Silky caramel custard, the classic Latin dessert.
steps: Caramelize the sugar in the pan.
Blend eggs, milks and vanilla and pour over.
Bake in a water bath at 350°F for 50 minutes; chill and invert.

recipes.name: Tapioca Pudding
recipes.description: Old-fashioned pudding with chewy tapioca pearls.
steps: Soak the tapioca, then simmer with milk and sugar.
Temper in beaten eggs and cook until thick.
Stir in vanilla and chill.

recipes.name: Vanilla Ice Cream
recipes.description: Rich homemade vanilla ice cream.
steps: Whisk yolks and sugar, temper in warm cream and milk.
Cook to a custard, chill, then churn.
Freeze until firm.
