recipes.name: Chocolate Ice Cream
recipes.description: Deeply chocolate churned ice cream.
steps: Whisk cocoa, sugar and yolks into warm cream and milk.
Cook to a custard and chill.
Churn and freeze until firm.

recipes.name: Strawberry Sorbet
recipes.description: Bright dairy-free sorbet from fresh strawberries.
steps: Simmer sugar and water into a syrup and cool.
Blend with strawberries and lemon.
Churn or freeze, stirring occasionally.

recipes.name: Mango Sorbet
recipes.description: Smooth tropical sorbet from ripe mango.
steps: Blend mango, sugar, lime and water until smooth.
Pour into a container.
Freeze, stirring every hour, until scoopable.

recipes.name: Banana Nice Cream
recipes.description: Two-ingredient soft serve from frozen bananas — vegan and naturally sweet.
steps: Blend the frozen bananas with milk and vanilla until creamy.
Scrape down and blend again until smooth.
Serve soft or freeze briefly to firm up.

recipes.name: Chocolate Nice Cream
recipes.description: Frozen banana soft serve blended with cocoa.
steps: Blend frozen bananas, cocoa, milk and maple until creamy.
Scrape and blend again.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Fruit Popsicles
recipes.description: Frozen pops from blended real fruit — no added sugar needed.
steps: Blend the fruit with juice, honey and water.
Pour into popsicle molds.
Freeze 4 hours.

recipes.name: Yogurt Berry Popsicles
recipes.description: Creamy frozen yogurt pops swirled with berries.
steps: Mix yogurt, honey and vanilla.
Swirl in mashed berries and pour into molds.
Freeze 4 hours.

recipes.name: Chocolate Covered Strawberries
recipes.description: Fresh strawberries dipped in glossy dark chocolate.
steps: Melt chocolate with coconut oil.
Dip the strawberries and place on parchment.
Sprinkle with nuts and chill to set.

recipes.name: Chocolate Truffles
recipes.description: Rich ganache truffles rolled in cocoa.
steps: Pour hot cream over chocolate and stir to a ganache.
Chill, then roll into balls.
Coat in cocoa powder.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Balls
recipes.description: No-bake peanut butter balls dipped in chocolate.
steps: Mix peanut butter, sugar and butter and roll into balls.
Chill, then dip in melted chocolate.
Set on parchment until firm.

recipes.name: Date Brownie Bites
recipes.description: No-bake fudgy bites from dates, cocoa and walnuts.
steps: Blend walnuts, then add dates, cocoa, salt and vanilla.
Process into a sticky dough.
Roll into balls and chill.

recipes.name: Classic Cheesecake
recipes.description: Rich, creamy baked cheesecake on a graham crust.
steps: Press crumbs into a pan.
Beat cream cheese, sugar, eggs and sour cream and pour over.
Bake at 325°F for 60 minutes; chill overnight.

recipes.name: No-Bake Cheesecake
recipes.description: A creamy chilled cheesecake that needs no oven.
steps: Press crumbs into a pan.
Whip cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and cream until fluffy.
Spread over the crust and chill 4 hours.

recipes.name: Strawberry Cheesecake
recipes.description: Creamy cheesecake topped with fresh strawberry sauce.
steps: Press crumbs into a pan and add the cream cheese filling.
Bake at 325°F for 60 minutes; chill.
Top with strawberry sauce.

recipes.name: Tiramisu
recipes.description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with mascarpone cream.
steps: Whisk yolks and sugar, fold in mascarpone.
Dip ladyfingers in espresso and layer with cream.
Dust with cocoa and chill 4 hours.

recipes.name: Chocolate Mousse
recipes.description: Airy, rich chocolate mousse.
steps: Melt the chocolate and cool slightly.
Whip cream with sugar and vanilla, then fold in chocolate.
Chill 2 hours.

recipes.name: Lemon Mousse
recipes.description: Light, tangy lemon mousse.
steps: Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Fold in condensed milk, lemon juice and zest.
Chill 2 hours.

recipes.name: Apple Crumble
recipes.description: Warm spiced apples under a buttery oat crumble.
steps: Toss apples with cinnamon and a little sugar in a dish.
Rub oats, flour, butter and sugar into a crumble.
Top the apples and bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Berry Cobbler
recipes.description: Juicy berries under a soft cakey biscuit top.
steps: Spread berries in a dish.
Whisk flour, sugar, milk and butter and pour over.
Bake at 375°F for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Peach Cobbler
recipes.description: Sweet baked peaches under a golden cobbler crust.
steps: Toss peaches with a little sugar in a dish.
Pour over a batter of flour, sugar, milk and butter.
Bake at 375°F for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Poached Pears
recipes.description: Pears gently poached in spiced syrup.
steps: Simmer water, sugar, cinnamon and lemon.
Add pears and poach 25 minutes.
Serve in the reduced syrup.

recipes.name: Grilled Peaches
recipes.description: Caramelized grilled peaches with honey and yogurt.
steps: Brush peaches with butter and grill cut-side down.
Drizzle with honey.
Serve with yogurt and pistachios.

recipes.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
recipes.description: Individual cakes with a molten chocolate center.
steps: Melt chocolate and butter, whisk in sugar, eggs and flour.
Pour into greased ramekins.
Bake at 425°F for 12 minutes until the edges set.

recipes.name: Chocolate Mug Cake
recipes.description: A single-serving chocolate cake made in the microwave.
steps: Whisk all the ingredients in a mug.
Microwave 90 seconds.
Let cool slightly and eat from the mug.

recipes.name: Affogato Dessert Cups
recipes.description: Vanilla gelato drowned in hot espresso, the Italian classic.
steps: Scoop gelato into cups.
Pour a shot of hot espresso over each.
Top with shaved chocolate.

recipes.name: S'mores Dip
recipes.description: Melted chocolate and toasted marshmallow for dunking graham crackers.
steps: Spread chocolate in a skillet over butter.
Top with marshmallows.
Broil until golden; dip graham crackers.

recipes.name: Churros
recipes.description: Crispy fried dough sticks rolled in cinnamon sugar.
steps: Boil water with butter, beat in flour, then eggs.
Pipe and fry until golden.
Roll in cinnamon sugar.

recipes.name: Banana Pudding
recipes.description: Layered Southern dessert of vanilla pudding, bananas and wafers.
steps: Layer wafers, banana and pudding in a dish.
Repeat the layers.
Top with whipped cream and chill.

recipes.name: Key Lime Pie Bars
recipes.description: Tangy lime custard bars on a graham crust.
steps: Press crumbs and butter into a pan and bake 10 minutes.
Whisk condensed milk, yolks and lime and pour over.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes; chill.

recipes.name: Stuffed Baked Apples
recipes.description: Whole apples baked with an oat, nut and cinnamon filling.
steps: Mix oats, walnuts, maple and cinnamon.
Stuff into the cored apples.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Honey Lime Fruit Salad
recipes.description: A bright mix of fresh fruit in a honey-lime dressing.
steps: Combine all the fruit.
Whisk honey and lime and toss in.
Chill before serving.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chia Pudding
recipes.description: A rich chocolate pudding that sets from chia overnight.
steps: Whisk all the ingredients together.
Refrigerate overnight.
Stir and top with berries.

recipes.name: Apple Pie Bites
recipes.description: Cinnamon apple slices wrapped in crescent dough.
steps: Roll each apple slice in a strip of crescent dough.
Brush with butter and cinnamon sugar.
Bake at 375°F for 12 minutes.

recipes.name: Frozen Chocolate Banana Pops
recipes.description: Banana halves on sticks dipped in chocolate and nuts.
steps: Insert sticks and freeze the bananas 1 hour.
Dip in melted chocolate.
Roll in peanuts and freeze until set.

recipes.name: Mexican Hot Chocolate Cookies
recipes.description: Fudgy chocolate cookies with cinnamon and a hint of cayenne.
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Mix in flour, cocoa, cinnamon and a pinch of cayenne.
Roll in sugar and bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Coconut Macaroons
recipes.description: Chewy toasted coconut mounds dipped in chocolate.
steps: Mix coconut, condensed milk, vanilla and whipped egg whites.
Scoop mounds onto a tray.
Bake at 325°F for 20 minutes; drizzle with chocolate.

recipes.name: Almond Biscotti
recipes.description: Crunchy twice-baked Italian cookies for dunking.
steps: Mix into a dough with the almonds and shape into a log.
Bake 25 minutes, slice, then bake again 10.
Cool until crisp.

recipes.name: Berry Pavlova
recipes.description: A crisp meringue shell topped with cream and berries.
steps: Whip egg whites and sugar to stiff glossy peaks.
Shape and bake at 250°F for 75 minutes.
Top with cream and berries.

recipes.name: Fruit & Nut Chocolate Bark
recipes.description: Dark chocolate bark studded with dried fruit and nuts.
steps: Melt the chocolate and spread on parchment.
Scatter nuts, fruit and seeds.
Sprinkle salt and chill to set; break into pieces.

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Fudge
recipes.description: Three-ingredient creamy chocolate fudge.
steps: Melt chocolate with condensed milk and butter.
Stir in vanilla and pour into a pan.
Chill until firm; cut into squares.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Pie Bars
recipes.description: Spiced pumpkin custard bars on a shortbread base.
steps: Press crumbs and butter into a pan.
Whisk pumpkin, sugar, eggs and spice and pour over.
Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes; chill.

recipes.name: Almond Flour Cookies
recipes.description: Soft, gluten-free cookies made with almond flour.
steps: Mix all the ingredients into a dough.
Scoop onto a lined tray and flatten.
Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Strawberry Shortcake
recipes.description: Sweet biscuits layered with strawberries and whipped cream.
steps: Toss strawberries with sugar and let macerate.
Layer biscuit, strawberries and cream.
Top with the biscuit lid.

recipes.name: Matcha Ice Cream
recipes.description: Earthy green-tea ice cream.
steps: Whisk matcha, sugar and yolks into warm cream and milk.
Cook to a custard and chill.
Churn and freeze.

recipes.name: Lemon Sorbet
recipes.description: Refreshing tart lemon sorbet.
steps: Simmer sugar and water into a syrup and cool.
Stir in lemon juice and zest.
Churn or freeze, stirring, until slushy-firm.

recipes.name: Watermelon Granita
recipes.description: Icy shaved watermelon dessert with lime.
steps: Blend watermelon, sugar and lime.
Pour into a shallow dish and freeze.
Scrape with a fork every 30 minutes until flaky.

recipes.name: Coffee Granita
recipes.description: Italian shaved-ice coffee dessert topped with cream.
steps: Stir sugar into hot coffee and cool.
Freeze in a shallow dish, scraping every 30 minutes.
Serve topped with whipped cream and cocoa.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Fudge
recipes.description: Smooth, melt-in-your-mouth peanut butter fudge.
steps: Melt peanut butter and butter, stir in vanilla.
Beat in powdered sugar and salt.
Press into a pan and chill until firm.

recipes.name: Brownie Cookies
recipes.description: Fudgy cookies with a shiny, crackly brownie top.
steps: Melt 1 cup chocolate with butter.
Whisk eggs and sugar, fold in chocolate, flour and remaining chips.
Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Rustic Apple Galette
recipes.description: A free-form apple tart with a buttery folded crust.
steps: Arrange apples on the crust and fold the edges in.
Dot with butter and sprinkle cinnamon sugar.
Bake at 400°F for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate Dipped Pretzels
recipes.description: Salty pretzels dipped in chocolate with sprinkles.
steps: Melt chocolate with coconut oil.
Dip the pretzels.
Add sprinkles and salt; chill to set.

recipes.name: Vegan Avocado Chocolate Mousse
recipes.description: Silky dairy-free chocolate mousse from ripe avocado.
steps: Blend all the ingredients until completely smooth.
Chill 1 hour.
Top with berries.

recipes.name: Oatmeal Raisin Bars
recipes.description: Chewy spiced oat bars studded with raisins.
steps: Mix oats, flour, sugar and butter, fold in raisins.
Press into a pan.
Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes; cut into bars.

recipes.name: Strawberry Frozen Yogurt
recipes.description: Tangy frozen yogurt from just strawberries, yogurt and honey.
steps: Blend frozen strawberries, yogurt, honey and lemon until smooth.
Serve soft.
Or freeze 1 hour for a firmer scoop.

recipes.name: Hazelnut-Stuffed Cookies
recipes.description: Chocolate cookies with a molten hazelnut-spread center.
steps: Cream butter and sugar, beat in egg, mix in flour.
Wrap dough around frozen spoonfuls of hazelnut spread.
Bake at 350°F for 12 minutes.

recipes.name: Lemon Poppy Seed Cookies
recipes.description: Bright, buttery cookies with lemon and poppy seeds.
steps: Cream butter and sugar with lemon zest, beat in egg.
Mix in flour and poppy seeds.
Bake at 350°F for 11 minutes.

recipes.name: Mango Sticky Rice
recipes.description: Sweet coconut sticky rice with fresh mango — a Thai classic.
steps: Steam the soaked sticky rice.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and stir into the rice.
Serve with mango and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Baklava
recipes.description: Flaky phyllo layered with spiced nuts and honey syrup.
steps: Layer phyllo with butter and walnut-cinnamon between.
Cut and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Pour over warm honey syrup and cool.

recipes.name: Chocolate Zucchini Brownies
recipes.description: Fudgy brownies with hidden zucchini for extra moisture.
steps: Mix oil, sugar and zucchini.
Fold in flour and cocoa.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Berry Yogurt Parfait
recipes.description: Layers of yogurt, berry compote and granola for a lighter dessert.
steps: Warm half the berries with honey into a quick compote.
Layer yogurt, compote and granola in glasses.
Top with fresh berries.

recipes.name: Chocolate Banana Bread Pudding
recipes.description: Custardy bread pudding with banana and chocolate chips.
steps: Whisk milk and eggs and pour over bread, banana and chips.
Soak 15 minutes.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Almond Coconut Bites
recipes.description: No-bake coconut bites topped with an almond and dipped in chocolate.
steps: Mix coconut and condensed milk and form mounds, pressing in an almond.
Chill, then dip in melted chocolate.
Set on parchment.

recipes.name: Lemon Ricotta Cake
recipes.description: A moist, light Italian cake made with ricotta.
steps: Beat ricotta, sugar and eggs, add lemon zest.
Fold in flour.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Frozen Greek Yogurt Fruit Bark
recipes.description: A frozen yogurt slab topped with mixed fruit and honey.
steps: Spread sweetened yogurt on a lined tray.
Top with fruit, granola and chia.
Freeze 3 hours and break into pieces.

recipes.name: Chocolate Orange Mousse
recipes.description: Airy chocolate mousse brightened with orange zest.
steps: Melt the chocolate with orange zest.
Whip cream and sugar, fold in chocolate.
Chill 2 hours.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Spice Mousse
recipes.description: Light, spiced pumpkin mousse folded with whipped cream.
steps: Whip the cream with sugar and vanilla.
Fold in pumpkin and spice.
Chill 2 hours.

recipes.name: Blueberry Crumble
recipes.description: Warm blueberries under a crisp oat-almond topping.
steps: Spread blueberries in a dish with a little sugar.
Rub oats, almond flour, butter and sugar into a crumble.
Top and bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Vegan Banana Oat Cookies
recipes.description: Three-ingredient soft cookies from banana and oats.
steps: Mash bananas and stir in oats, chocolate, cinnamon and salt.
Scoop onto a tray.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Tres Leches Cake
recipes.description: A sponge cake soaked in three milks and topped with cream.
steps: Poke the sponge cake all over.
Pour over the mixed three milks and soak.
Top with whipped cream and chill.

recipes.name: Chocolate Avocado Pudding
recipes.description: A creamy, dairy-free chocolate pudding from avocado and banana.
steps: Blend all the ingredients until silky.
Chill 30 minutes.
Serve topped with berries.

recipes.name: Baked Donut Bites
recipes.description: Fluffy baked donut holes rolled in cinnamon sugar.
steps: Whisk a quick batter and spoon into a mini muffin tin.
Bake at 375°F for 12 minutes.
Roll the warm bites in cinnamon sugar.

recipes.name: Strawberry Mousse
recipes.description: Light, fluffy mousse from fresh strawberries and cream.
steps: Purée the strawberries with lemon and sugar.
Whip the cream and fold in the purée.
Chill 2 hours.

recipes.name: Homemade Peanut Butter Cups
recipes.description: Two-layer chocolate cups with a creamy peanut butter center.
steps: Melt chocolate with oil and coat muffin liners.
Fill with peanut butter blended with sugar and salt.
Top with chocolate and chill to set.

recipes.name: Apple Cinnamon Nice Cream
recipes.description: Frozen banana soft serve with apple and warm cinnamon.
steps: Blend frozen bananas, apple, cinnamon, milk and maple until creamy.
Scrape and blend again.
Serve soft.

recipes.name: Classic Banana Bread
recipes.description: Moist, sweet banana bread speckled with walnuts.
steps: Mix mashed banana with sugar and eggs.
Fold in flour and walnuts.
Bake at 350°F for 55 minutes in a loaf pan.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Bread
recipes.description: Spiced pumpkin loaf, moist and fragrant.
steps: Whisk pumpkin, sugar, eggs and oil.
Fold in flour and spice.
Bake at 350°F for 60 minutes.

recipes.name: Cornbread
recipes.description: Golden, slightly sweet Southern cornbread.
steps: Whisk dry ingredients, then add milk, egg and melted butter.
Pour into a greased pan.
Bake at 400°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Rosemary Focaccia
recipes.description: Pillowy Italian flatbread dimpled with olive oil and rosemary.
steps: Mix flour, water and yeast into a wet dough and rise 1 hour.
Spread in an oiled pan, dimple and top with rosemary.
Bake at 425°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Garlic Naan
recipes.description: Soft, blistered Indian flatbread brushed with garlic butter.
steps: Mix flour, yogurt and yeast into a dough and rise 1 hour.
Roll and cook on a hot skillet until puffed.
Brush with garlic butter.

recipes.name: Irish Soda Bread
recipes.description: A quick rustic bread leavened with baking soda and buttermilk.
steps: Mix flour, soda and salt, stir in buttermilk and raisins.
Shape into a round and score a cross.
Bake at 425°F for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Soft Dinner Rolls
recipes.description: Fluffy buttery pull-apart rolls.
steps: Mix into a soft dough and rise 1 hour.
Shape into rolls and rise again.
Bake at 375°F for 18 minutes; brush with butter.

recipes.name: Soft Pretzels
recipes.description: Chewy golden pretzels with a salt topping.
steps: Mix and rise the dough, then shape into pretzels.
Boil briefly in baking soda water.
Bake at 425°F for 14 minutes; sprinkle salt.

recipes.name: Homemade Bagels
recipes.description: Chewy boiled-then-baked New York-style bagels.
steps: Mix and rise the dough, then shape into rings.
Boil 1 minute per side in honey water.
Bake at 425°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: English Muffins
recipes.description: Nooks-and-crannies muffins cooked on a griddle.
steps: Mix into a dough and rise 1 hour.
Cut rounds, dust with cornmeal.
Griddle on low 7 minutes per side.

recipes.name: Cherry Tomato Focaccia
recipes.description: Olive-oil focaccia studded with burst cherry tomatoes.
steps: Mix a wet dough and rise 1 hour.
Spread in a pan, press in tomatoes.
Bake at 425°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Garlic Knots
recipes.description: Knotted pizza dough baked and tossed in garlic butter.
steps: Cut and knot strips of dough.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Toss in garlic butter, parsley and parmesan.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Muffins
recipes.description: Tender bakery-style muffins loaded with chocolate chips.
steps: Whisk dry, then wet, and combine.
Fold in chips and fill muffin cups.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Banana Muffins
recipes.description: Moist banana muffins for grab-and-go breakfasts.
steps: Mix banana, sugar, egg and oil.
Fold in flour and fill muffin cups.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Bran Muffins
recipes.description: Hearty high-fiber bran muffins with raisins.
steps: Soak bran in buttermilk, then mix in molasses and egg.
Fold in flour and raisins.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Corn Muffins
recipes.description: Sweet, golden corn muffins.
steps: Whisk dry and wet separately, then combine.
Fill muffin cups.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Double Chocolate Muffins
recipes.description: Rich cocoa muffins with melty chocolate chips.
steps: Whisk dry, then add milk, egg and oil.
Fold in chips and fill cups.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Apple Cinnamon Muffins
recipes.description: Soft muffins packed with diced apple and cinnamon.
steps: Whisk a batter and fold in apple and cinnamon.
Fill muffin cups.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Cranberry Orange Muffins
recipes.description: Bright muffins with tart cranberries and orange zest.
steps: Whisk a batter with the orange zest.
Fold in cranberries and fill cups.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Muffins
recipes.description: Spiced pumpkin muffins, soft and moist.
steps: Mix pumpkin, sugar, egg and oil.
Fold in flour and spice and fill cups.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Carrot Muffins
recipes.description: Moist spiced muffins full of grated carrot.
steps: Mix carrot, sugar, eggs and oil.
Fold in flour and cinnamon.
Bake at 375°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Lemon Poppy Seed Muffins
recipes.description: Bright lemon muffins flecked with poppy seeds.
steps: Whisk a batter with lemon zest.
Fold in poppy seeds and fill cups.
Bake at 375°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Blueberry Scones
recipes.description: Buttery, tender scones bursting with blueberries.
steps: Cut cold butter into the flour and sugar.
Stir in cream and blueberries, shape and cut wedges.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Cranberry Orange Scones
recipes.description: Flaky scones with tart cranberries and orange zest.
steps: Cut butter into flour and sugar.
Add cream, cranberries and zest, shape and cut.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Cheddar Chive Scones
recipes.description: Savory flaky scones with sharp cheddar and chives.
steps: Cut butter into the flour.
Stir in cheddar, chives and cream, shape and cut.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Buttermilk Biscuits
recipes.description: Tall, flaky Southern biscuits.
steps: Cut cold butter into the flour, baking powder and salt.
Stir in buttermilk, fold and cut rounds.
Bake at 450°F for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Cheddar Garlic Biscuits
recipes.description: Fluffy drop biscuits with cheddar and garlic butter.
steps: Mix flour, cheddar and milk into a soft dough.
Drop onto a tray.
Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes; brush with garlic butter.

recipes.name: Classic Vanilla Cake
recipes.description: A tender, fluffy vanilla layer cake.
steps: Cream butter and sugar, beat in eggs.
Alternate flour and milk, then pour into pans.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate Layer Cake
recipes.description: Moist, rich chocolate cake for any celebration.
steps: Whisk dry, then add eggs, milk, oil and hot water.
Pour into two pans.
Bake at 350°F for 32 minutes.

recipes.name: Carrot Cake
recipes.description: Spiced carrot cake with cream cheese frosting.
steps: Mix carrot, sugar, eggs and oil.
Fold in flour and spice, pour into pans.
Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes; frost when cool.

recipes.name: Lemon Pound Cake
recipes.description: Dense, buttery pound cake with a bright lemon glaze.
steps: Cream butter and sugar, beat in eggs.
Fold in flour and lemon zest, pour into a loaf pan.
Bake at 325°F for 60 minutes.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Coffee Cake
recipes.description: Tender cake with a cinnamon streusel ribbon and topping.
steps: Make a batter and layer with cinnamon-sugar streusel.
Top with more streusel.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Red Velvet Cupcakes
recipes.description: Soft cocoa-tinged cupcakes with cream cheese frosting.
steps: Whisk a batter with red coloring and cocoa.
Fill cupcake liners.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes; frost when cool.

recipes.name: Vanilla Cupcakes
recipes.description: Light, fluffy vanilla cupcakes ready for frosting.
steps: Cream butter and sugar, beat in eggs.
Alternate flour and milk, fill liners.
Bake at 350°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Classic Apple Pie
recipes.description: A double-crust pie filled with cinnamon-spiced apples.
steps: Toss apples with sugar, flour and cinnamon.
Fill the crust, top with the second and crimp.
Bake at 400°F for 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Pie
recipes.description: Silky spiced pumpkin custard in a flaky crust.
steps: Whisk pumpkin, milk, eggs, sugar and spice.
Pour into the crust.
Bake at 375°F for 50 minutes; chill.

recipes.name: Pecan Pie
recipes.description: Gooey, sweet pecan filling in a buttery crust.
steps: Whisk corn syrup, sugar and eggs.
Stir in pecans and pour into the crust.
Bake at 350°F for 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Cherry Pie
recipes.description: A lattice-topped pie bursting with sweet-tart cherries.
steps: Toss cherries with sugar, cornstarch and lemon.
Fill the crust and top with a lattice.
Bake at 400°F for 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Blueberry Pie
recipes.description: A juicy double-crust blueberry pie.
steps: Toss blueberries with sugar, cornstarch and lemon.
Fill the crust and add the top.
Bake at 400°F for 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Lemon Meringue Pie
recipes.description: Tart lemon custard under a billowy toasted meringue.
steps: Cook a lemon curd with yolks, sugar and cornstarch and fill the crust.
Whip whites and sugar into meringue and pile on top.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Fresh Fruit Tart
recipes.description: A crisp tart shell filled with pastry cream and glazed fruit.
steps: Fill the baked shell with pastry cream.
Arrange the fruit on top.
Brush with warmed apricot glaze.

recipes.name: Apple Tarte Tatin
recipes.description: An upside-down caramelized apple tart.
steps: Caramelize sugar and butter in a pan and arrange apples.
Top with pastry and bake at 400°F for 30 minutes.
Invert onto a plate to serve.

recipes.name: Blueberry Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy pancakes dotted with fresh blueberries.
steps: Whisk a batter and fold in the blueberries.
Cook on a buttered griddle until bubbling, then flip.
Serve with syrup.

recipes.name: Banana Pancakes
recipes.description: Naturally sweet pancakes with mashed banana.
steps: Whisk batter with the mashed banana.
Cook on a buttered griddle, flipping once.
Serve with syrup and banana slices.

recipes.name: Protein Pancakes
recipes.description: High-protein pancakes from oats, banana and protein powder.
steps: Blend all the ingredients into a batter.
Cook on a buttered griddle, flipping once.
Top with berries.

recipes.name: Belgian Waffles
recipes.description: Crisp-outside, fluffy-inside waffles.
steps: Whisk dry and wet separately, then fold together.
Cook in a hot waffle iron until golden.
Serve with syrup and berries.

recipes.name: Buttermilk Waffles
recipes.description: Tangy, crisp buttermilk waffles.
steps: Whisk a batter and rest 5 minutes.
Cook in a waffle iron until golden.
Serve hot with syrup.

recipes.name: French Toast
recipes.description: Custard-dipped bread griddled golden and dusted with sugar.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla.
Dip the bread and griddle in butter both sides.
Dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Classic Crepes
recipes.description: Thin, delicate French pancakes for sweet or savory fillings.
steps: Blend flour, milk, eggs, butter and salt into a thin batter.
Swirl into a hot pan and cook briefly per side.
Fill and fold.

recipes.name: Dutch Baby Pancake
recipes.description: A dramatic oven-puffed pancake dusted with lemon and sugar.
steps: Blend flour, milk and eggs into a batter.
Heat butter in a skillet and pour in the batter.
Bake at 425°F for 18 minutes; dust with sugar and lemon.

recipes.name: Glazed Donuts
recipes.description: Light fried yeast donuts with a sweet vanilla glaze.
steps: Mix and rise a soft dough, then cut rings.
Fry until golden and drain.
Dip in a powdered-sugar glaze.

recipes.name: Baked Cinnamon Donuts
recipes.description: Cake-style donuts baked, not fried, and rolled in cinnamon sugar.
steps: Whisk a batter and pipe into a donut pan.
Bake at 350°F for 12 minutes.
Brush with butter and roll in cinnamon sugar.

recipes.name: Apple Turnovers
recipes.description: Flaky puff pastry pockets filled with spiced apple.
steps: Cook apples with sugar and cinnamon into a filling.
Spoon onto pastry squares, fold and seal.
Brush with egg and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Cheese Danish
recipes.description: Flaky pastry with a sweet cream cheese center.
steps: Beat cream cheese, sugar, yolk and vanilla.
Spoon onto pastry squares and fold the corners.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Cream Puffs
recipes.description: Airy choux pastry shells filled with sweet cream.
steps: Boil water and butter, beat in flour, then eggs, to make choux.
Pipe mounds and bake at 400°F for 25 minutes.
Cool, split and fill with cream.

recipes.name: Chocolate Éclairs
recipes.description: Choux pastry filled with cream and topped with chocolate glaze.
steps: Make choux paste and pipe into logs; bake at 400°F for 30 minutes.
Fill with pastry cream.
Dip the tops in chocolate glaze.

recipes.name: Palmiers
recipes.description: Crisp, caramelized French puff-pastry 'elephant ear' cookies.
steps: Sprinkle pastry with cinnamon sugar and roll both sides to the center.
Slice and lay flat on a tray.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes, flipping once.

recipes.name: Popovers
recipes.description: Tall, hollow, eggy rolls with crisp shells.
steps: Blend flour, milk, eggs, butter and salt.
Pour into a hot greased popover pan.
Bake at 425°F for 30 minutes; don't open the oven.

recipes.name: Brioche Loaf
recipes.description: A rich, buttery French enriched bread.
steps: Mix a rich dough and knead in the butter; rise 2 hours.
Shape into a loaf and rise again.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Challah
recipes.description: A glossy braided egg bread.
steps: Mix and knead a soft dough; rise 1.5 hours.
Divide, roll ropes and braid.
Brush with egg and bake at 375°F for 28 minutes.

recipes.name: Ciabatta
recipes.description: Rustic Italian bread with a chewy open crumb.
steps: Mix a very wet dough and rise 2 hours.
Gently shape two loaves on a floured surface.
Bake at 450°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: French Baguette
recipes.description: A crackly-crusted classic French loaf.
steps: Mix a lean dough and rise 1.5 hours.
Shape into long loaves and score.
Bake at 450°F with steam for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Zucchini Bread
recipes.description: Moist quick bread with grated zucchini and cinnamon.
steps: Mix zucchini, sugar, eggs and oil.
Fold in flour and cinnamon, pour into a loaf pan.
Bake at 350°F for 55 minutes.

recipes.name: Glazed Lemon Loaf
recipes.description: A bright lemon quick bread with a tangy glaze.
steps: Cream butter and sugar, beat in eggs and lemon zest.
Fold in flour and pour into a loaf pan.
Bake at 350°F for 50 minutes; glaze with lemon icing.

recipes.name: Focaccia Rolls
recipes.description: Individual olive-oil rolls with rosemary and sea salt.
steps: Mix and rise a soft dough.
Portion into an oiled muffin tin and dimple.
Bake at 425°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Raisin Bread
recipes.description: Soft swirled loaf with cinnamon sugar and raisins.
steps: Mix and rise a soft dough.
Roll out, sprinkle cinnamon sugar and raisins, then roll into a loaf.
Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Pecan Sticky Buns
recipes.description: Gooey caramel-pecan rolls baked upside down.
steps: Pour caramel and pecans into the pan.
Roll cinnamon-sugar dough, slice and place on top.
Bake at 350°F for 28 minutes; invert.

recipes.name: Hot Cross Buns
recipes.description: Spiced sweet buns with dried fruit and a piped cross.
steps: Mix a spiced dough with raisins and rise.
Shape buns, pipe a flour-paste cross.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes; glaze.

recipes.name: Classic Cream Scones
recipes.description: Light, barely-sweet scones perfect with jam and cream.
steps: Cut butter into the flour, sugar and baking powder.
Stir in cream, fold and cut wedges.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Almond Croissants
recipes.description: Croissants filled with almond cream and toasted almonds.
steps: Split croissants and brush with syrup.
Fill and top with almond cream and almonds.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes; dust with sugar.

recipes.name: Pain au Chocolat
recipes.description: Flaky laminated pastry wrapped around dark chocolate.
steps: Roll the dough and lay chocolate batons inside.
Roll up and brush with egg.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Savory Herb Scones
recipes.description: Flaky scones with herbs and parmesan.
steps: Cut butter into flour.
Stir in parmesan, herbs and cream, shape and cut.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate Babka
recipes.description: A swirled enriched bread laced with chocolate.
steps: Mix a rich dough and rise.
Roll out, spread chocolate, roll and twist into a loaf.
Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Apple Fritters
recipes.description: Craggy fried dough studded with apple and cinnamon.
steps: Whisk a batter and fold in apple and cinnamon.
Fry spoonfuls until golden.
Glaze or dust with sugar.

recipes.name: Banana Chocolate Chip Muffins
recipes.description: Moist banana muffins loaded with chocolate chips.
steps: Mix banana, sugar, egg and oil.
Fold in flour and chips, fill cups.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Morning Glory Muffins
recipes.description: Hearty muffins with carrot, apple, raisins and coconut.
steps: Mix the wet and dry ingredients into a batter.
Fold in carrot, apple, raisins and coconut.
Bake at 375°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Sourdough Bread
recipes.description: A tangy, crusty artisan loaf raised with starter.
steps: Mix flour, water, starter and salt and fold over several hours.
Shape and cold-proof overnight.
Bake in a Dutch oven at 475°F for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Whole Wheat Bread
recipes.description: A wholesome sandwich loaf with whole-wheat flour and honey.
steps: Mix and knead a soft dough; rise 1 hour.
Shape into a loaf and rise again.
Bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Brioche Burger Buns
recipes.description: Soft, glossy enriched buns for burgers.
steps: Mix a rich dough and rise 1.5 hours.
Shape into buns and rise again.
Brush with egg and bake at 375°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Oatmeal Muffins
recipes.description: Wholesome muffins made with oats and a hint of maple.
steps: Soak oats in milk, then mix in maple, egg and flour.
Fill muffin cups.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Savory Cheese Muffins
recipes.description: Fluffy savory muffins loaded with cheddar and herbs.
steps: Whisk a batter and fold in cheddar and chives.
Fill muffin cups.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Jam Thumbprint Cookies
recipes.description: Buttery cookies with a well of fruit jam.
steps: Cream butter and sugar, mix in flour and yolk.
Roll balls, press a well and fill with jam.
Bake at 350°F for 12 minutes.

recipes.name: Madeleines
recipes.description: Delicate shell-shaped French sponge cakes with a buttery edge.
steps: Whip eggs and sugar until pale, fold in flour and butter.
Spoon into a madeleine pan.
Bake at 375°F for 11 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Scones
recipes.description: Tender scones studded with chocolate chips.
steps: Cut butter into the flour and sugar.
Stir in cream and chips, shape and cut wedges.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Pita Bread
recipes.description: Soft rounds that puff into pockets in a hot oven.
steps: Mix and rise a soft dough.
Roll into rounds and rest.
Bake at 475°F for 5 minutes until puffed.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Scones
recipes.description: Spiced pumpkin scones with a maple glaze.
steps: Cut butter into the flour, sugar and spice.
Stir in pumpkin and a little cream, shape and cut.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes; drizzle maple glaze.

recipes.name: Monkey Bread
recipes.description: Pull-apart cinnamon-sugar dough balls baked in caramel.
steps: Toss dough pieces in cinnamon sugar.
Layer in a bundt pan with pecans and pour over butter-sugar.
Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes; invert.

recipes.name: Cheese Straws
recipes.description: Crisp, flaky cheddar puff-pastry twists.
steps: Brush pastry with egg and sprinkle cheese and paprika.
Cut strips and twist.
Bake at 400°F for 14 minutes.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Swirl Quick Bread
recipes.description: A no-yeast loaf with a cinnamon sugar swirl.
steps: Make a quick-bread batter.
Layer with cinnamon sugar and swirl with a knife.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate Banana Muffins
recipes.description: Rich cocoa muffins made moist with banana.
steps: Mix banana, sugar, egg and oil.
Fold in flour and cocoa and fill cups.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Rugelach
recipes.description: Flaky cream-cheese pastry rolled around fruit and nuts.
steps: Make a cream-cheese dough and chill.
Roll, spread jam and nuts, cut wedges and roll up.
Bake at 350°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Bacon Cheddar Scones
recipes.description: Hearty savory scones with bacon and sharp cheddar.
steps: Cut butter into the flour.
Stir in cheddar, bacon and cream, shape and cut.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Caramelized Onion Focaccia
recipes.description: Olive-oil focaccia topped with sweet caramelized onions.
steps: Mix a wet dough and rise.
Spread in a pan, dimple, top with onions.
Bake at 425°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Whole Grain Berry Muffins
recipes.description: Wholesome whole-wheat muffins bursting with berries.
steps: Whisk a batter with maple and egg.
Fold in berries and fill cups.
Bake at 375°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Soft Pretzel Bites
recipes.description: Bite-size chewy pretzels for dipping.
steps: Mix and rise a dough, then cut into bites.
Boil briefly in baking soda water.
Bake at 425°F for 12 minutes; salt them.

recipes.name: Keto Chicken Alfredo Zoodles
recipes.description: Creamy parmesan alfredo over zucchini noodles with chicken — pasta-free.
steps: Sear the chicken, then set aside.
Simmer cream, garlic and parmesan into a sauce.
Toss in zucchini noodles and chicken and warm through.

recipes.name: Keto Bacon Cheeseburger Bowl
recipes.description: All the burger, none of the bun — beef, bacon, cheddar over crisp lettuce.
steps: Brown the beef and crisp the bacon.
Pile over lettuce with tomato.
Top with cheddar.

recipes.name: Keto Meatloaf
recipes.description: A grain-free meatloaf bound with almond flour and parmesan.
steps: Mix beef, almond flour, egg and parmesan and shape into a loaf.
Top with sugar-free ketchup.
Bake at 375°F for 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Garlic Butter Salmon
recipes.description: Pan-seared salmon in garlic butter with asparagus.
steps: Sear the salmon and set aside.
Sauté asparagus in garlic butter.
Return salmon, baste, finish with lemon.

recipes.name: Keto Cauliflower Fried Rice
recipes.description: Riced cauliflower stir-fried with chicken and egg — a low-carb takeout swap.
steps: Scramble the eggs and set aside.
Stir-fry chicken, add cauliflower rice and soy.
Fold in egg and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Keto Garlic Shrimp Zoodles
recipes.description: Garlic-butter shrimp over zucchini noodles.
steps: Sauté shrimp in garlic butter until pink.
Add zucchini noodles and toss 2 minutes.
Finish with lemon.

recipes.name: Keto Beef and Broccoli
recipes.description: Tender beef and broccoli in a sugar-free soy-ginger sauce.
steps: Sear the beef and set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli with ginger.
Return beef, add soy and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Egg Roll in a Bowl
recipes.description: Deconstructed egg roll — ground pork and cabbage, no wrapper.
steps: Brown the pork with ginger.
Add cabbage and soy and stir-fry until tender.
Finish with sesame oil.

recipes.name: Keto Taco Bowl
recipes.description: Seasoned beef over lettuce with cheese, avocado and salsa — no shell.
steps: Brown beef with taco seasoning.
Pile over lettuce.
Top with cheese and avocado.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: Roasted cauliflower in a rich cheddar sauce — low-carb comfort food.
steps: Roast or steam the cauliflower.
Make a cheddar cream sauce with butter and nutmeg.
Fold in cauliflower and bake 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Chicken Parmesan
recipes.description: Almond-flour-breaded chicken with marinara and mozzarella.
steps: Bread cutlets in egg and almond flour and pan-fry.
Top with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Creamy Tuscan Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken thighs in a creamy garlic-parmesan spinach sauce.
steps: Sear the chicken thighs and set aside.
Simmer cream, garlic, parmesan and spinach.
Return chicken and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Cobb Bowl
recipes.description: Chicken, egg, bacon, avocado and blue cheese over greens.
steps: Arrange greens in a bowl.
Top with chicken, egg, bacon, avocado and blue cheese.
Drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.name: Keto Philly Cheesesteak Peppers
recipes.description: Bell peppers stuffed with steak, onion and melted provolone.
steps: Sear steak and onion in oil.
Fill the peppers and top with provolone.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Salmon Cakes
recipes.description: Salmon patties bound with almond flour instead of breadcrumbs.
steps: Mix salmon, almond flour, egg and dill into patties.
Pan-fry in oil 3 minutes per side.
Serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Keto Chaffles
recipes.description: Cheesy almond-flour waffles you make in a waffle iron — keto bread swap.
steps: Whisk eggs, mozzarella and almond flour.
Cook in a waffle iron 4 minutes.
Serve savory or with sugar-free syrup.

recipes.name: Keto Cream Cheese Pancakes
recipes.description: Two-ingredient grain-free pancakes that fry up tender.
steps: Blend cream cheese, eggs, vanilla and cinnamon.
Pour small rounds onto a buttered pan.
Flip once and serve with berries.

recipes.name: Keto Breakfast Bowl
recipes.description: Eggs, avocado, bacon and spinach — a high-fat start with no carbs.
steps: Crisp the bacon and wilt the spinach.
Fry or scramble the eggs.
Arrange in a bowl with avocado.

recipes.name: Keto Sausage Egg Muffins
recipes.description: Baked egg cups with sausage and cheese — grab-and-go keto.
steps: Whisk eggs and cream, stir in sausage and cheese.
Pour into a muffin tin.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Avocado Green Smoothie
recipes.description: A creamy low-carb smoothie from avocado, spinach and almond milk.
steps: Add almond milk, then spinach, avocado, almond butter and chia.
Blend on high until smooth.
Pour and serve cold.

recipes.name: Keto Almond Flour Bread
recipes.description: A sliceable grain-free sandwich loaf from almond flour and eggs.
steps: Whisk eggs and butter, then mix in almond flour, baking powder and salt.
Pour into a loaf pan.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Coconut Flour Muffins
recipes.description: Light coconut-flour muffins sweetened with erythritol.
steps: Whisk eggs, butter, erythritol and vanilla.
Stir in coconut flour and rest 5 minutes.
Bake at 350°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Fathead Bagels
recipes.description: Chewy grain-free bagels from mozzarella dough.
steps: Melt mozzarella and cream cheese, mix in almond flour, egg and baking powder.
Shape into rings.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Cinnamon Rolls
recipes.description: Fathead-dough cinnamon rolls with a sugar-free glaze.
steps: Make fathead dough and roll out.
Sprinkle cinnamon and erythritol, roll and slice.
Bake at 375°F for 18 minutes; drizzle sugar-free glaze.

recipes.name: Keto Blueberry Muffins
recipes.description: Almond-flour muffins studded with blueberries, no sugar.
steps: Whisk eggs, butter and erythritol.
Fold in almond flour and blueberries.
Bake at 350°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Cheddar Biscuits
recipes.description: Fluffy almond-flour drop biscuits loaded with cheddar.
steps: Mix almond flour, cheddar, eggs, butter and baking powder.
Drop onto a tray.
Bake at 375°F for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Pumpkin Bread
recipes.description: A moist low-carb pumpkin loaf with warm spice.
steps: Whisk eggs, pumpkin and erythritol.
Fold in almond flour and spice.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Cheesecake
recipes.description: Creamy baked cheesecake on an almond-flour crust, no sugar.
steps: Press almond flour crust into a pan.
Beat cream cheese, erythritol, eggs and vanilla.
Bake at 325°F for 50 minutes; chill.

recipes.name: Keto Fudge Brownies
recipes.description: Dense fudgy brownies from almond flour and unsweetened cocoa.
steps: Whisk butter, erythritol and eggs.
Fold in almond flour and cocoa.
Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Chewy almond-flour cookies with sugar-free chocolate chips.
steps: Cream butter and erythritol, beat in egg.
Mix in almond flour and chips.
Bake at 350°F for 11 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Peanut Butter Cookies
recipes.description: Three-ingredient flourless peanut butter cookies, sugar-free.
steps: Mix peanut butter, erythritol, egg and vanilla.
Roll into balls and press with a fork.
Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Keto Chia Pudding
recipes.description: A low-carb pudding set from chia in coconut milk.
steps: Whisk all the ingredients together.
Refrigerate overnight until thick.
Top with a few berries.

recipes.name: Keto Chocolate Fat Bombs
recipes.description: Rich coconut-oil and cocoa bites for a quick keto treat.
steps: Melt coconut oil and almond butter.
Whisk in cocoa, erythritol and salt.
Pour into molds and freeze.

recipes.name: Keto Lemon Mousse
recipes.description: Light, tangy whipped lemon mousse, sugar-free.
steps: Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Fold in lemon, zest and erythritol.
Chill 2 hours.

recipes.name: Healthy Zucchini Bread
recipes.description: Whole-wheat zucchini bread sweetened with maple and applesauce instead of oil and sugar.
steps: Mix zucchini, applesauce, maple and eggs.
Fold in whole wheat flour and cinnamon.
Bake at 350°F for 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Healthy Carrot Cake
recipes.description: A lighter carrot cake with whole-wheat flour, Greek yogurt and maple.
steps: Mix carrot, yogurt, maple and eggs.
Fold in whole wheat flour, cinnamon and walnuts.
Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Healthy Banana Bread
recipes.description: Naturally sweetened banana bread with whole-wheat flour and no refined sugar.
steps: Mash bananas with honey, eggs and yogurt.
Fold in whole wheat flour.
Bake at 350°F for 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Almond Flour Blueberry Muffins
recipes.description: Gluten-free muffins with almond flour, maple and fresh blueberries.
steps: Whisk eggs, maple and oil.
Fold in almond flour and blueberries.
Bake at 350°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Oat Flour Banana Muffins
recipes.description: Tender muffins made with ground-oat flour and ripe banana.
steps: Mash banana with maple and eggs.
Stir in oat flour and baking powder.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Berry Muffins
recipes.description: High-protein muffins made moist with Greek yogurt.
steps: Whisk yogurt, honey and eggs.
Fold in flour and berries.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Applesauce Oat Muffins
recipes.description: Oil-free muffins sweetened and moistened with applesauce.
steps: Mix applesauce, maple and cinnamon.
Stir in flour and oats.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Whole Wheat Banana Pancakes
recipes.description: Fiber-rich pancakes sweetened with banana.
steps: Whisk banana, egg and milk.
Stir in flour and baking powder.
Cook on a griddle, flipping once.

recipes.name: Oat Flour Pancakes
recipes.description: Light gluten-free pancakes from blended oats.
steps: Whisk egg, milk and maple.
Stir in oat flour and baking powder.
Cook on a griddle until bubbling, then flip.

recipes.name: Protein Banana Bread
recipes.description: Banana bread boosted with protein powder for a higher-protein slice.
steps: Mash banana with eggs and yogurt.
Fold in flour and protein powder.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Black Bean Brownies
recipes.description: Fudgy flourless brownies from blended black beans — you'd never know.
steps: Blend black beans, cocoa, maple, eggs and oil until smooth.
Pour into a pan.
Bake at 350°F for 28 minutes.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Brownies
recipes.description: Naturally sweet flourless brownies from mashed sweet potato.
steps: Mix sweet potato, maple and eggs.
Fold in almond flour and cocoa.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Flourless Banana Oat Muffins
recipes.description: Blender muffins from oats and banana — no flour, no refined sugar.
steps: Blend oats, banana, eggs, honey and baking powder.
Pour into muffin cups.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Healthy Pumpkin Bread
recipes.description: Whole-wheat pumpkin loaf sweetened with maple.
steps: Whisk pumpkin, maple and eggs.
Fold in flour and spice.
Bake at 350°F for 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Cornbread
recipes.description: Lighter cornbread made tender with Greek yogurt and a touch of honey.
steps: Whisk yogurt, honey and eggs.
Stir in cornmeal and flour.
Bake at 400°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Banana Oatmeal Breakfast Cookies
recipes.description: Soft cookies from banana, oats and raisins — no added sugar.
steps: Mash banana and stir in oats, raisins, walnuts and cinnamon.
Scoop onto a tray.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Whole Grain Blueberry Scones
recipes.description: Lighter scones with whole-wheat flour, Greek yogurt and fresh blueberries.
steps: Mix yogurt, maple and oil into the flour.
Fold in blueberries, shape and cut wedges.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Almond Flour Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy grain-free, low-carb pancakes from almond flour.
steps: Whisk eggs, almond milk and maple.
Stir in almond flour and baking powder.
Cook on a buttered griddle, flipping once.

recipes.name: Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls
recipes.description: Soft cinnamon rolls made with whole-wheat flour and a Greek yogurt glaze.
steps: Mix and rise a whole-wheat dough.
Roll with cinnamon and maple, slice.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes; glaze with yogurt.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Lemon Loaf
recipes.description: A bright lemon loaf kept moist with Greek yogurt and sweetened with honey.
steps: Whisk yogurt, honey, eggs and lemon zest.
Fold in flour.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Oat Flour Waffles
recipes.description: Crisp gluten-free waffles from blended oats.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, oil and maple.
Stir in oat flour.
Cook in a waffle iron until golden.

recipes.name: Healthy Chocolate Banana Muffins
recipes.description: Rich-tasting cocoa muffins sweetened with banana and maple.
steps: Mash banana with maple and eggs.
Fold in flour and cocoa.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Zucchini Oat Muffins
recipes.description: Moist whole-grain muffins packed with grated zucchini and oats.
steps: Mix zucchini, maple and eggs.
Fold in oats and flour.
Bake at 375°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Healthy Pumpkin Muffins
recipes.description: Whole-wheat pumpkin muffins with maple and warm spice.
steps: Whisk pumpkin, maple and eggs.
Fold in flour and spice.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Pancakes
recipes.description: Blender pancakes from oats and banana — naturally sweet, no flour.
steps: Blend oats, banana, eggs, milk and baking powder.
Cook small rounds on a griddle.
Flip once and serve.

recipes.name: Almond Flour Zucchini Bread
recipes.description: A grain-free, gluten-free zucchini loaf sweetened with maple.
steps: Whisk eggs and maple, stir in zucchini.
Fold in almond flour and cinnamon.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Date-Sweetened Banana Bread
recipes.description: Banana bread sweetened entirely with blended dates — no sugar or honey.
steps: Blend dates into a paste and mix with banana, eggs and yogurt.
Fold in flour.
Bake at 350°F for 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Whole Wheat Pumpkin Scones
recipes.description: Tender whole-grain scones with pumpkin and Greek yogurt.
steps: Mix pumpkin, yogurt and maple into the flour.
Shape and cut wedges.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Healthy Carrot Muffins
recipes.description: Whole-wheat carrot muffins with applesauce, raisins and walnuts.
steps: Mix carrot, applesauce and cinnamon.
Fold in flour, raisins and walnuts.
Bake at 375°F for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Quinoa Breakfast Cookies
recipes.description: Hearty cookies from cooked quinoa, oats and banana.
steps: Mix banana and almond butter, stir in quinoa, oats and cranberries.
Scoop onto a tray.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Cheesecake
recipes.description: A lighter, higher-protein cheesecake using Greek yogurt and an oat crust.
steps: Blend oats into a crust and press into a pan.
Beat yogurt, cream cheese, honey and eggs.
Bake at 325°F for 40 minutes; chill.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Nice Cream
recipes.description: Creamy soft-serve from frozen banana and peanut butter — dairy-free.
steps: Blend frozen banana, peanut butter, milk and vanilla until creamy.
Scrape and blend again.
Serve soft.

recipes.name: Date Caramel Apple Dip
recipes.description: A naturally sweet 'caramel' from blended dates for dipping apples.
steps: Blend dates, almond butter, water and salt into a smooth caramel.
Serve with apple slices.
Store the dip refrigerated.

recipes.name: Chia Berry Pudding
recipes.description: A no-cook pudding set from chia in almond milk, topped with berries.
steps: Whisk chia, almond milk, maple and vanilla.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with berries.

recipes.name: Protein Frozen Yogurt Bark
recipes.description: A frozen Greek-yogurt slab boosted with protein and topped with berries.
steps: Stir protein and honey into the yogurt and spread on a tray.
Top with berries and almonds.
Freeze 3 hours and break into pieces.

recipes.name: Chocolate Protein Balls
recipes.description: No-bake energy balls with oats, protein and peanut butter.
steps: Mix everything into a stiff dough.
Roll into balls.
Chill 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Honey Baked Pears with Walnuts
recipes.description: Halved pears baked with honey, cinnamon and walnuts.
steps: Place pears in a dish and drizzle with honey and cinnamon.
Scatter walnuts.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes; serve with yogurt.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Fruit Parfait
recipes.description: Layers of Greek yogurt, berries and granola — a high-protein dessert.
steps: Layer yogurt, berries and granola in glasses.
Drizzle with honey and chia.
Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Almond Clusters
recipes.description: Antioxidant-rich dark chocolate and almond bites.
steps: Melt dark chocolate with coconut oil.
Stir in almonds and spoon clusters onto parchment.
Sprinkle salt and chill to set.

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Banana Bites
recipes.description: Banana coins dipped in dark chocolate and frozen.
steps: Freeze banana coins 1 hour.
Dip in melted dark chocolate and roll in peanuts.
Freeze until set.

recipes.name: No-Bake Oat Energy Bites
recipes.description: Chewy no-bake bites of oats, peanut butter and honey.
steps: Mix everything into a sticky dough.
Roll into balls.
Chill 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Mango Coconut Chia Pudding
recipes.description: A tropical chia pudding layered with fresh mango.
steps: Whisk chia, coconut milk and maple and chill overnight.
Layer with diced mango.
Top with shredded coconut.

recipes.name: Grilled Pineapple with Honey
recipes.description: Caramelized grilled pineapple drizzled with honey and lime.
steps: Grill the pineapple slices until charred.
Drizzle with honey and lime.
Serve with yogurt and a dusting of cinnamon.

recipes.name: Protein Yogurt Popsicles
recipes.description: Creamy frozen yogurt pops with a protein boost and berries.
steps: Blend yogurt, protein, honey and vanilla.
Swirl in mashed berries and pour into molds.
Freeze 4 hours.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Protein Cookies
recipes.description: Higher-protein flourless peanut butter cookies.
steps: Mix peanut butter, protein, egg and honey.
Scoop and flatten on a tray.
Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Almond Date Truffles
recipes.description: No-bake truffles from dates, almonds and cocoa.
steps: Blend almonds, then add dates, cocoa and salt into a dough.
Roll into balls.
Roll in shredded coconut.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Spice Chia Pudding
recipes.description: A cozy chia pudding flavored with pumpkin and warm spice.
steps: Whisk all the ingredients together.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with chopped pecans.

recipes.name: Strawberry Banana Nice Cream
recipes.description: Two-fruit soft serve, naturally sweet and dairy-free.
steps: Blend frozen banana, strawberries, milk and lemon until creamy.
Scrape and blend again.
Serve soft.

recipes.name: Chocolate Protein Mousse
recipes.description: A high-protein chocolate mousse from Greek yogurt and cocoa.
steps: Whisk yogurt, protein, cocoa, honey and vanilla until fluffy.
Chill 30 minutes.
Top with berries.

recipes.name: Coconut Date Balls
recipes.description: No-bake bites of dates, coconut and almonds.
steps: Blend dates, coconut, almonds, oil and salt into a dough.
Roll into balls.
Roll in extra coconut and chill.

recipes.name: Baked Cinnamon Bananas
recipes.description: Warm baked banana halves with cinnamon and walnuts.
steps: Place bananas in a dish, drizzle with maple and cinnamon.
Scatter walnuts.
Bake at 375°F for 18 minutes; serve with yogurt.

recipes.name: Baked Cinnamon Apple Chips
recipes.description: Crispy oven-dried apple slices with cinnamon — no added sugar.
steps: Toss apple slices with cinnamon and lemon.
Arrange on lined trays.
Bake at 225°F for 90 minutes until crisp.

recipes.name: Berry Frozen Yogurt
recipes.description: Three-ingredient frozen yogurt from frozen berries.
steps: Blend frozen berries, yogurt, honey and lemon until smooth.
Serve soft.
Or freeze 1 hour for a firmer scoop.

recipes.name: Matcha Chia Pudding
recipes.description: An antioxidant-rich green-tea chia pudding.
steps: Whisk matcha into the almond milk, then stir in chia, maple and vanilla.
Refrigerate overnight.
Stir and serve.

recipes.name: No-Bake Granola Bars
recipes.description: Chewy oat and peanut butter bars held together with honey.
steps: Warm peanut butter and honey, stir into oats, chia and chocolate.
Press firmly into a pan.
Chill 1 hour and cut into bars.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Cheesecake Cups
recipes.description: No-bake individual cheesecakes lightened with Greek yogurt.
steps: Whip yogurt, cream cheese and honey until smooth.
Layer over granola in cups.
Top with berries and chill.

recipes.name: Chocolate Avocado Truffles
recipes.description: Silky truffles from ripe avocado and dark chocolate.
steps: Melt the chocolate and blend with avocado, maple and salt.
Chill, then roll into balls.
Dust with cocoa.

recipes.name: Strawberry Chia Jam Yogurt
recipes.description: Greek yogurt swirled with a quick no-sugar chia strawberry jam.
steps: Mash strawberries with chia and honey and let thicken.
Swirl into the yogurt.
Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Honey Roasted Figs
recipes.description: Fresh figs roasted with honey and served over yogurt.
steps: Drizzle figs with honey and balsamic and roast at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Spoon over yogurt.
Top with pistachios.

recipes.name: Banana Date Ice Cream
recipes.description: Frozen banana soft serve sweetened with dates.
steps: Blend frozen banana, dates, milk and vanilla until creamy.
Scrape and blend again.
Serve soft.

recipes.name: Chocolate Protein Mug Cake
recipes.description: A single-serve high-protein chocolate cake in 90 seconds.
steps: Whisk all the ingredients in a mug.
Microwave 90 seconds.
Top with berries.

recipes.name: Healthy Brown Rice Pudding
recipes.description: Creamy rice pudding made with brown rice, almond milk and maple.
steps: Simmer brown rice with almond milk and maple, stirring.
Cook 20 minutes until creamy.
Stir in cinnamon and raisins.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Protein Balls
recipes.description: No-bake bites of pumpkin, oats and protein.
steps: Mix everything into a dough.
Roll into balls.
Chill 30 minutes.
